jobs.title: Patient Outcome Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Kheir Clinic** is committed to providing culturally and linguistically-sensitive quality healthcare and human services to the underserved and uninsured residents of Los Angeles.

**Kheir Clinic** was established in 1986 to serve as a bridge between low-income, recently-immigrated, non-English speaking Korean community and local health and social service providers. Today, Kheir is a broad-based agency providing comprehensive health care for a diverse population through its 7 clinics (Federally Qualified Health Center sites), Adult Day Health Care Center and Patient Resources Department.

**MISSION:**

Kheir's mission is to increase and provide access to culturally and linguistically-sensitive quality primary healthcare and human services support to the underserved and uninsured residents of Southern California.

**ASSIGNMENT SUMMARY:**

The Patient Outcome Project Coordinator (POPC) supports the planning, coordination, and execution of both internally initiated and externally driven projects, while providing day-to-day administrative and organizational support to the Operations department. This role works closely with Operations leadership and cross-functional teams to keep projects organized, track timelines and deliverables, facilitate clear communication, and ensure operational priorities move forward efficiently and effectively.

The POPC is a key support role within the organization and is responsible for keeping project and operational details organized, maintaining accurate documentation, coordinating meetings and follow-ups, and helping teams stay aligned on priorities and deliverables. The POPM reports to the Associate Vice President of Operations,

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Project Coordination & Support:**

* Support assigned projects with the planning, coordination, and execution from initiation through completion.
* Maintain project timelines, task lists, status trackers, and other project documentation.
* Coordinate project meetings, including scheduling, agendas, meeting notes, action items, and follow-up.
* Track project deliverables, milestones, deadlines, and outstanding items to help keep projects on schedule.
* Follow up with internal teams and stakeholders regarding assigned tasks and deadlines.
* Help identify potential delays, gaps, or issues and escalate them to supervisor.
* Assist with preparing project updates, status reports, presentations, and other project-related materials.
* Maintain organized project files, documentation, and records.
* Help coordinate communication between departments and ensure relevant information is shared with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support project closeout activities, including documentation, outstanding action items, and lessons learned.

**Operations Support:**

* Provide administrative and coordination support to the Operations department and Operations leadership.
* Assist with tracking operational priorities, tasks, deadlines, and initiatives.
* Maintain operational spreadsheets, trackers, reports, and documentation.
* Coordinate internal meetings, recurring operational check-ins, and follow-up activities.
* Help document and maintain standard operating procedures, processes, and workflows.
* Support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of operational processes and systems.
* Assist with collecting, organizing, and reporting operational data and information.
* Help coordinate cross-functional operational initiatives and ensure action items are followed through.
* Support scheduling, logistics, vendor coordination, purchasing, or other administrative activities as needed.
* Identify opportunities to improve organization, communication, and efficiency within day-to-day operations.

**Communication & Cross-Functional Coordination:**

* Serve as a reliable point of coordination between Project Management, Operations, and other internal departments.
* Communicate project and operational updates clearly and professionally.
* Follow up proactively with stakeholders to keep tasks and initiatives moving.
* Build positive working relationships across teams and contribute to a collaborative work environment.
* Ensure information, decisions, and action items are documented and communicated appropriately.

**Training and Capability:**

* Provide training and education to clinic staff on approved project-specific workflows, compliance regulations, process improvement methodologies, safety protocols, and best practices.
* Support operational and quality-improvement initiatives when assigned as formal projects, while functional authority remains with the responsible department leader.
* Other duties as assigned.

**REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE AND COMPETENCIES:**

* **Project coordination fundamentals**, including supporting scope, timelines, milestones, deliverables, budgets, and risk tracking.
* **Strong oral and written communication**, including preparing project updates, status reports, meeting materials, and other communications for internal stakeholders and leadership.
* **Problem-solving and issue identification**, including recognizing potential risks, delays, or barriers and escalating them appropriately.
* **Critical thinking and sound judgment**, with the ability to assess priorities, identify next steps, and know when to seek guidance or escalate concerns.
* **Project tracking and accountability**, including maintaining action items, monitoring deliverables and deadlines, and supporting the collection and reporting of project outcomes.
* **Familiarity with clinic operations**, sufficient to effectively coordinate with clinical, administrative, and operational teams.
* **Strong time-management and organizational skills**, including the ability to coordinate multiple projects, priorities, and competing deadlines.
* **Cross-functional collaboration and influence**, including the ability to build relationships, facilitate communication, and gain cooperation across departments without direct authority.
* **Attention to detail

jobs.title: Youth Program Specialist
jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* Company parties
* Competitive salary
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance

**Job Purpose/Summary**

The Youth Program Specialist provides culturally responsive, strengths-based support services to American Indian, Alaska Native, and Indigenous youth. This position promotes positive youth development, cultural identity, resilience, educational success, behavioral health, and overall well-being through mentoring, advocacy and community engagement.

The Youth Program Specialist is responsible for recruiting and engaging American Indian, Alaska Native and Indigenous youth to participate in youth services at Sacred Path Indigenous Wellness Center. They will receive instruction on the Motivational Interviewing and Culture for Native American Youth (MICUNAY) curriculum and facilitate workshops (both virtual and in person) with this curriculum for youth ages 12-17 and 18-26. The Youth Program Specialist will also provide mentoring and peer support.

The Youth Program Specialist works collaboratively with youth, families, Tribal communities, elders, schools, behavioral health providers, and community partners to support youth in achieving their goals while honoring Indigenous values, traditions, and cultural practices. The position is expected to uphold principles of cultural humility, trauma-informed care, and community-centered service delivery.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

**Youth Engagement and Support**

* Establish trusting, supportive relationships with American Indian, Alaska Native, and Indigenous youth.
* Develop workshop content, agendas, and learning materials to align with the desired outcomes and target audience. Place orders for materials (and food, if applicable) and secure a site, if necessary.
* Lead workshops by engaging participants through various interactive methods, encouraging discussions, and managing group dynamics. Ensure that workshops follow required procedures (e.g., sign-in sheets, surveys).
* Clearly communicate workshop objectives, expectations, and guidelines to participants, ensuring a shared understanding.
* Provide individual/group mentoring and peer support.
* Assist youth in identifying personal, educational, career, cultural, and wellness goals.
* Promote leadership development, self-advocacy, and life skills.
* Encourage healthy social, emotional, spiritual, and cultural development.
* Support youth participation in cultural, traditional, and community activities.

**Cultural and Community-Based Services**

* Incorporate Indigenous values, traditions, and cultural practices into service delivery.
* Strengthen cultural identity, community connections and sense of belonging.
* Collaborate with elders, cultural practitioners, Tribal representatives, and community leaders to support programming.
* Assist with planning and facilitating cultural events, workshops, and youth activities.
* Promote respect for cultural diversity and community traditions.

**Documentation and Program Compliance**

* Assist with data collection and reporting requirements for grants and contracts.
* Track program outcomes and performance measures.
* Collect participant feedback, evaluate workshop effectiveness, and make improvements.
* Ensure confidentiality and compliance with policies and applicable regulations.
* Keep supervisor(s) informed of any concerns or challenges.

**Collaboration and Community Outreach**

* Work with Youth Services Program Coordinators to maximize outreach via social media accounts by creating content, posting and interacting with community regularly.
* Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with schools, Tribal organizations, and community partners.
* Work with subcontractors to support in facilitating workshops; assist in ordering materials; ensure workshop procedures are followed; attend workshops to assist as needed.
* Conduct outreach and recruitment activities within Indigenous communities.
Represent Sacred Path at community meetings, events, and cultural gatherings, as needed.  

**Other**

Perform additional duties, as needed, in support of Sacred Path’s mission.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Must be between 18 and 26 years of age (funding source requirement)
* Strong interpersonal, communication and relationship-building skills, capable of creating a positive and inclusive learning environment.
* Flexibility to adapt to different learning styles, participant backgrounds, and unexpected challenges.
* Effective organizational and time-management skills.
* Knowledge of positive youth development and trauma-informed care principles.
* Understanding of the historical and contemporary experiences impacting American Indian, Alaska Native, and Indigenous communities.

Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Reservations & Events Coordinator
jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:** Reservations & Events Coordinator

**DEPARTMENT:** Sales

**REPORTS TO:** Director of Sales

**STATUS:** Full-Time, Hourly/Non-Exempt

**WORK LOCATION:** 100% Onsite, $21.50 per hour

**START YOUR JOURNEY WITH US**

When you join the Sheraton Garden Grove - Anaheim South family, you become part of a global community. Since 1937, Sheraton has been a place to gather and connect. At Sheraton, associates create a sense of belonging in more than 400 communities around the world. We invite, we welcome, and we connect guests through engaging experiences and thoughtful service. If you're a team player who is excited to deliver a meaningful guest experience, we encourage you to explore your next career opportunity with us. Join us on our mission to be 'The World's Gathering Place'! Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing team, and become the best version of you.We offer a collaborative environment along with perks such as daily complimentary buffet-style meals, team-building activities, employee recognition programs, and an annual holiday celebration.

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Reservations & Events Coordinator is a full-time, onsite position within the Sales Department that combines responsibilities supporting hotel reservations, group room blocks, catering, and events.

The position provides reservations and group coordination support based on hotel business levels and seasonal needs, while also supporting the Catering Sales Manager with the coordination and execution of meetings, catered events, site tours, and other group functions.

A key responsibility of this position is providing weekend event and Sales & Catering coverage. The Reservations & Events Coordinator works closely with the Catering Sales Manager, Director of Sales, Food & Beverage team, Front Desk, and other hotel departments to help ensure accurate reservations, effective communication, and a smooth client and guest experience from the planning stages through the completion of an event.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Events & Catering Support**

* Supports the Catering Sales Manager with the planning, coordination, and execution of meetings, catered events, social functions, and group activities.
* Provides onsite coverage for scheduled events, particularly on weekends, based on the hotel's event calendar and business needs.
* Serves as an onsite point of contact for assigned events and assists with communicating client needs and event requirements to appropriate hotel departments.
* Greets clients, meeting planners, and event guests in a warm and professional manner.
* Conducts property and event-space tours for prospective and confirmed clients as assigned.
* Assists with gathering event details, client requests, timelines, and other information needed for upcoming functions.
* Assists with the preparation and distribution of Banquet Event Orders (BEOs) and related event documentation under the direction of the Catering Sales Manager.
* Reviews upcoming event information and assists with ensuring relevant departments have the information necessary to execute scheduled functions.
* Assists with client communication and follow-up by telephone and email as directed.
* Provides administrative support for proposals, event correspondence, client files, appointments, calendars, and other Sales & Catering documentation.
* Communicates with Food & Beverage, Front Desk, Housekeeping, Engineering, and other departments regarding event and group requirements.
* Assists with event setup coordination and conducts event-space checks as needed.
* Monitors assigned events while in progress and communicates client requests, concerns, or operational issues to the appropriate manager or department.
* Assists with transitioning clients and event information to the appropriate operational teams.
* Maintains organized and accurate event and catering files and records.
* Assists with hotel sales activities, guest events, community activities, and other Sales & Catering initiatives as assigned.
* Attends Sales, Catering, BEO, and other departmental meetings as requested.

**Reservations & Group Coordination**

* Processes reservations received from the Sales Department and other hotel departments by telephone, email, central reservation systems, and other approved channels.
* Creates new reservations and accurately processes changes and cancellations in the Property Management System (PMS).
* Communicates reservation information and confirmations to guests and relays relevant information to the Front Desk, Sales Department, and other appropriate parties.
* Supports group, tour, and FIT reservations as assigned.
* Creates and maintains group room blocks in applicable hotel systems, including CI/TY and Lightspeed.
* Processes rooming lists and records requests for special accommodations.
* Serves as a liaison between the hotel and housing companies or reservation platforms for assigned groups and conventions.
* Monitors group pickup, room type availability, cutoff dates, and other reservation requirements and communicates concerns to Sales leadership.
* Maintains and monitors rates and availability in accordance with established hotel procedures.
* Accurately records special billing instructions, group codes, transient business codes, and other reservation information.
* Processes applicable no-shows, credit card information, advance deposits, and cash deposits accurately and in a timely manner.
* Assists with master arrival reports, VIP reservations, and pre-stay correspondence.
* Handles daily reservation correspondence and responds to inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
* Assists with group preregistration activities, including preparation of key packets, breakfast vouchers, welcome letters, and room blocking.
* Communicates potential sellout dates, reservation concerns, discrepancies, or unusual matters to the appropriate manager.

jobs.description:

Collects data for clinical trials research, independently. Prepares and/or supports the submission of study documentation to regulatory bodies (e.g., IRB) for pre-implementation review and approval. May support clinical trials activities and research lab operations. Completes timely and accurate documentation of all research activities (e.g., consent forms, reports). Assists with the development and/or implementation of standard and non-standard quality control and/or assurance measures and documents feedback to research staff and management. Supports and develops materials for the education of research staff and/or participants on protocols, documentation procedures, clinical best practices, or timeliness of submissions, with limited guidance. Learns about providing input on implementing budgeting components for internally funded standard and non-standard projects. Drafts and/or prepares and submits clinical trials applications in compliance and consistency with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations and KP policies and procedures.

Adapts to and learns from change, challenges, and feedback; demonstrates flexibility in approaches to work; helps others adapt to new tasks and processes. Supports and responds to the needs of others to support a business outcome.

* Maintains internal and external effective working relationships by: leveraging a comprehensive foundational knowledge of how to partner with research stakeholders and investigators within and across units to contribute to research projects; independently communicating with key contractors and subcontractors, study sponsors, collaborating internal and/or external clinical sites, and data coordinating centers as applicable; and developing materials for supporting the education of staff and/or participants on protocols, documentation procedures, clinical best practices, or timeliness of submissions with limited guidance.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and energetic Digital Marketing Coordinator to join our innovative marketing team. In this role, you will be at the forefront of developing and executing compelling digital marketing strategies that elevate brand visibility and drive engagement across multiple channels. Your expertise will help craft impactful campaigns, optimize online presence, and analyze performance metrics to ensure continuous growth. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast-paced environment where creativity and technical proficiency come together to deliver measurable results.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop, implement, and manage comprehensive digital marketing campaigns across platforms including social media, search engines, email, and display advertising.
* Utilize SEO tools and conduct keyword research to enhance website visibility and organic traffic.
* Manage paid advertising campaigns using Google Ads, Facebook Advertising, and other paid media channels to maximize ROI.
* Optimize conversion rates through A/B testing, landing page improvements, and user experience enhancements.
* Create engaging content for websites, social media, email marketing, and other digital channels that aligns with brand voice and marketing goals.
* Manage website content using WordPress and content management systems while ensuring website health with technical skills like HTML, CSS, and website management tools.
* Analyze web analytics reports using Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics platforms to track campaign performance and generate actionable insights for continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience with digital marketing tools such as SEO tools, Google Ads (AdWords), Google Analytics, SEM (Search Engine Marketing), and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong knowledge of social media management and advertising campaigns on platforms like Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, or Twitter.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite including Photoshop for content creation and graphic design purposes.
* Familiarity with website management systems such as WordPress or similar CMS platforms.
* Technical skills in web analytics reporting, and web analytics tools to support campaign setup and performance tracking.
* High level of competency with AI tools, ChatGPT and Claude.
* Experience in e-commerce environments or B2B marketing is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams while managing multiple projects efficiently.
* A proactive mindset with a passion for staying current on digital marketing trends and best practices.

Join us as a Digital Marketing Coordinator to harness your creativity and technical skills in a role that fuels growth through innovative digital strategies!

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance

* Life insurance
* Paid time off

jobs.description:
### **Sales Coordinator**

Department

Event Services

Type

Regular

Status

Full-time

**SUMMARY**
-----------

Image

The Sales Coordinator is responsible for supporting the marketing and selling of the California Science Center Foundation’s (“Foundation”) third party (external) events and assisting with internal and external event management as needed. Provides daily support with client sales communication, site tour scheduling, and calendar management. Confirms bookings by drafting and distributing Event Reservation Agreement and billing and collecting deposits. Supports event marketing and social media initiatives.

**QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------

* BA Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications or related field.
* 2+ years of professional marketing or sales experience in a related field.
* Experience managing promotional campaigns, client outreach, advertising and social media preferred, but not required.
* Specialty venue, hotel, hospitality industry, catering or Convention & Visitor Bureau experience to promote and sell our destination preferred, but not required.
* Proficient knowledge of event planning and management.
* Experience executing contracts preferred, but not required.
* Superb organizational skills with great attention to detail.
* Excellent organizational, interpersonal and verbal/written communications skills.
* Must be a task-oriented self-starter with a high level of motivation.
* Available to occasionally support events outside of standard work shift, including evenings and weekends, with advance notice.

* Assists with third party and internal events as needed.
* Assists VP with special projects.
* Performs other duties as required.

**COMPENSATION**
----------------

$26.50 - $29.00 per hour

**APPLICATION PROCESS**
-----------------------

Email all application materials (Resume, Cover Letter, Application) to **HR@californiasciencecenter.org**

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. The California Science Center Foundation is dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Production Coordinator, Materials Labs - Temporary
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

**PRODUCTION COORDINATOR, MATERIALS LABS - TEMPORARY**

The Production Control Coordinator is a critical position within our team. This role is responsible for serving as a liaison between our internal lab team and the customers (we support requests from every program at the company) we support, ensuring that materials and test articles flow smoothly through the lab to meet stringent deadlines and quality standards.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Monitor, track, and move parts as required through the company to ensure timely delivery to next production location
* Ensure parts are handled, packaged and protected properly within SpaceX specifications
* Ensure that scans and location accuracy is maintained within the shop and SpaceX's ERP system
* Coordinate with supply chain teams to ensure on-time delivery of piece parts and outside services as required
* Work with the planning, procurement, engineering, and production teams to ensure ERP data is and remains clean and accurate
* Assist with resolution of incorrect system data which is driving inappropriate demand, schedules, or could result in general failure
* Develop and maintain reports to highlight needs, deliverables and constraints as required for internal and customer use
* Support logistics process through innovative staging of workflow as required
* Support management of material certifications as required – prevent use of un-certified materials
* Interface and coordinate with outsource vendors for any external material testing

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High school diploma or equivalency certificate
* 1+ years of experience supporting administrative processes

**PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* 3+ years of experience handling parts in a manufacturing setting
* Strong computer skills and familiar MS Office Suite
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in organizing files and documents
* Inventory experience
* Experience with MRP/ERP systems
* Experience in aerospace, automotive, semiconductor, or electronic manufacturing environments
* SQL and Tableau experience
* APICS certification

**ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Must be willing to work all shifts, overtime, and weekends as needed
* Nominal hours – 1st shift (6:00 AM – 4:30 PM)
* Able to lift 25 lbs. unassisted
* Able to stand for extended periods – 8 hours min

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:**  
  
Pay Range:  
Level 1: $22.00 - $24.50  
Level 2: $24.00 - $27.50  
Level 3: $27.00 - $31.00

  

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for potential discretionary bonuses. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, and various other discounts and perks. You will also be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

**ITAR REQUIREMENTS:**

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**ABOUT DOT.CARDS**
===================

dot.cards is the digital business card of the future. We produce premium networking hardware that pairs with a software platform that lets anyone share their contact info, in seconds. With 2.5M+ devices sold and 100M+ in-person connections facilitated, we have built strong momentum and clear product-market fit. We are now focused on scaling that foundation significantly across channels, products, and customer segments. Based in LA, we are a revenue-backed, fast-growing company entering our next phase of growth.

**THE ROLE**
============

We are hiring an Operations Coordinator to support the Head of Operations. This is a full-time, entry-level role for someone who wants to learn how a hardware company runs, from the factory to the customer.

Reporting directly to the Head of Operations, you will act as their right hand on operations: keeping inventory, suppliers, shipments, and reporting on track, and making sure commitments made get done.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
====================

* Coordinate with customer support, sales, procurement and the warehouse to support the custom product order process from order confirmation to delivery.
* Support weekly Amazon FBA replenishment: build the order, confirm inventory quantities, and review with Head of Operations for approval of shipping carton labels.
* Assist the Head of Sales by tracking action items from meetings, and follow up directly with owners on status and deadlines until each one is closed
* Track product development status, collect prototype and production quotes, sample shipments, follow up on action items and keep the product development tracker current.
* Coordinate monthly sales and operations planning (S&OP) readiness across departments and schedule meetings accordingly.
* Write and maintain SOPs for recurring operations workflows and flag any workflow that has not been written down yet.
* Coordinate in-house sample production, prioritize production schedule maintain inventory levels and document most effective customization parameters.
* Maintain one running list of open items with owner and due date and flag anything overdue or at risk.
* Check vendor invoices and forward them to accounts payable and receipts to our expense system
* Set up new SKUs, bundles, and maintain item master data in our document control database.
* Handle office facilities requests, including cleaning and other vendors and landlord requests
* Draft decks, spreadsheets, and briefs for review
* Order lab and office supplies and keep them stocked

**WHAT YOU WILL LEARN**
=======================

* How a hardware company runs operations end to end, working directly with the Head of Sales and Operations
* Supply chain and procurement with overseas manufacturers, from purchase order to delivered goods
* 3PL fulfillment and inventory planning across Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop
* How operations reporting drives purchasing and planning decisions

  **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
  ===========================

**Required**
------------

* 1 to 3 years of experience in an operations, logistics, coordinator, or executive assistant role, ideally in a fast-moving environment; also open to recent graduates and students in their final year of study with relevant internship or part-time experience
* Interest in supply chain, logistics, or manufacturing, through coursework, internships, or work experience
* Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets: comfortable with formulas, pivot tables, and building trackers from scratch
* Detail-oriented and organized, comfortable juggling multiple trackers, deadlines, and follow-ups at once
* Comfortable following up with people, including holding others accountable to deadlines they have committed to
* Clear written communicator who can draft a professional email or message without heavy editing
* Reliable, shows up, and follows through without needing reminders
* Comfortable asking questions and flagging problems early rather than guessing
* Able to lift and pack boxes up to 25 lbs

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, or a 3PL or warehouse management portal

**COMPENSATION & DETAILS**
==========================

* $29.00 to $34.00/hour
* Full-time, entry level
* Onsite at dot.cards HQ in Culver City, CA
* Start date: as soon as we find the right person
* Reports to: Head of Sales and Operations

**Equal Opportunity Employer:** dot.cards is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Accommodation Statement:** We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process. If you require assistance or accommodation, please contact hr@dot.cards.

jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Our Place, we believe in the power of home-cooking to bring people together. We design thoughtful, beautiful products that make cooking and sharing meals easier and more joyful—and we are building a brand that earns a meaningful place in customers’ homes over time.

Welcome to Our Place. We believe that sharing a home-cooked meal is the very best way to connect. That’s why we create products that simplify home-cooking; it’s why we celebrate traditions with families given, chosen, and found; and it’s why we share those stories with you, directly from the people and places where they originate.

The Social Media Coordinator/ Content Creator reports to the Head of Social and is responsible for executing high-impact, social-first video content that drives engagement, brand awareness, and revenue growth across Our Place. This role is hands-on and execution-focused, with ownership of day-to-day TikTok content creation, video production, community-driven initiatives, specific Founder-led content, and platform growth strategies. The Social Media Coordinator/ Content Creator partners closely with the Founders, Creative, and Marketing teams to bring the brand to life through compelling, timely, and culturally relevant content.

**We have a hybrid working culture and are looking for this person to be on site 2 - 3 times a week at our brand new Our Place headquarters in West Los Angeles.**

### **What you'd do**

* **Content Creation & Production**

  + Interpret the monthly social media calendar to develop and execute TikTok content aligned with strategy, marketing goals, brand, and messaging guidelines
  + Lead end-to-end TikTok content production, including ideation, filming, editing, and publishing with oversight and creative direction from the Head of Social
  + Be comfortable creating food and cooking-focused content, including basic food preparation and minimal food styling for camera
  + Deliver a minimum of one TikTok per weekday and one Founder-led piece of content per month
* **Community Engagement**

  + Lead and manage the TikTok Bulletin Board and Instagram Broadcast Channel, driving community engagement initiatives tied to product drops and key brand moments
  + Support the Head of Social in community management across all social platforms by monitoring comments, engaging with followers, and identifying opportunities to drive engagement and brand affinity
* **Planning & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

  + Assist the Head of Social in executing social and brand-building initiatives, coordinating across teams on projects including events, influencer and community seeding, partnerships, and other key brand moments.
  + Plan and deliver weekly TikTok content strategy meetings with the Head of Social, ensuring all content is produced ahead of scheduled posting dates and executed within established timelines and budgets
  + Partner cross-functionally with Social, Creative Production, and Marketing teams as needed.

### **Who you are**

* 1–2 years of experience in social media, content creation, or a related role
* Strong interest in social media, pop culture, food, and trends
* A genuine love of food and cooking, with an eye for how food can be captured beautifully and naturally on social
* Familiarity with TikTok, Instagram, and evolving social platforms, with an understanding of what feels native to each
* Comfortable filming and editing short-form video content, with an eagerness to continue developing these skills
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and deadlines with guidance from the Head of Social
* Flexible and willing to travel locally to Our Place stores, events, shoots, and other locations to capture content as needed
* Adaptable and comfortable with shifting priorities, quick turnarounds, and last-minute opportunities
* Action-oriented, proactive, and willing to jump in wherever needed
* Collaborative, receptive to feedback, and eager to learn and grow within the Social team

### **What we offer at Our Place**

* Competitive pay and real-deal equity — we want you to have a slice of what we’re building together
* A chance to share in our wins — all full-time team members are eligible for our discretionary annual bonus plan
* Benefits that actually benefit — top-tier medical, dental, and vision to keep you feeling your best
* Plenty of time off — generous PTO, and synchronized time off (we all log off together so you can actually rest)
* We invest in you — $500 a year for learning & development, plus an optional 401k plan so future you is covered
* All the kitchen treats — team member discount, an annual our place gift card, and of course, lots of our place goodies for your home
* A workspace worth leaving your house for — a beautiful office with a creative studio, multiple kitchens, and plenty of room for big ideas
* Tuesday lunches — catered meals so you can catch up with your teammates over something delicious
* A culture of connection — team events, activities, and an annual company retreat because we like hanging out together
* A team full of kind, thoughtful humans who actually care — because the people make this place

*This range reflects the good-faith estimate of compensation Our Place reasonably expects to pay for the position upon hire.*

  

*All information you submit in connection with your application to Our Place is processed in accordance with Our Place's* *Global Applicant Privacy Policy**.*

**Account Manager - Survey & Geospatial Equipment (Sales) – Orange County**

**Who we are**

California Surveying & Drafting Supply (CSDS) helps clients capture, transform, and manage data, leading to increased field-to-finish efficiency and profitability.

We accelerate the adoption of technology to create, capture, and manage geospatial, construction, and design data. By delivering high-impact outcomes through industry-leading solutions, unparalleled expertise, and excellent client experience, we transform clients, grow our people, and deliver exceptional results.

**Position Summary**

California Surveying & Drafting Supply (CSDS) is seeking an experienced, driven Sales Representative to join its Land Survey and Construction Division. Reporting to the Survey Sales Manager, the successful candidate will be responsible for the demonstration, promotion and sale of high-end land surveying products and will possess a proven track record of success in closing complex solution sales. This position will be based at our Anaheim, California office. The sales territory will consist of Orange County and surrounding areas.

**In this role, you will...**

The Survey Sales Representative will be responsible for meeting or exceeding annual sales targets in the assigned region by:

* Actively seeking leads and sales opportunities
* Identifying and developing key vertical markets in the territory
* Interfacing and developing strong relationships with key end users
* Closing sales to end users of land surveying hardware and software solutions
* Presenting complex technical sales presentations
* Explaining ROI and clear financial benefits of the Trimble surveying portfolio
* Attending tradeshows and industry events
* Traveling extensively in the territory to ensure close customer contact

**About you...**

* Knowledge of land surveying / engineering / laser scanning / photogrammetry / aerial / land mobile and other Geospatial technologies highly desired but not mandatory
* Direct sales skills - track record of success
* Solution selling with strong ability to communicate ROI
* Business planning
* Presentation skills / speaking ability - to drive new technologies
* Land surveying, civil engineering, geography and/or business, finance, economics) and 2-5+ years of field experience with sales in the GIS, civil engineering, land surveying, aerial mapping, infrastructure or construction fields
* Experience in sales

**Why choose us?**

* A salary commensurate with your experience, plus a generous sales commission (On-target-earnings between $120K-$140K per year).
* ESOP company stock option
* Company paid 401K contribution guaranteed.
* Vacation Accrual, Sick and Holiday pay
* Company Vehicle and Fuel Card - Phone, Computer, Demonstration Equipment
* Permanent, Full-Time Employment
* Full medical and Dental insurance paid by company (less $25 employee contribution)
* And more!

jobs.description:
Los Angeles, California, United States of America
  
Orange County, California, United States of America Sales Ref ID: JR-022873

  

**Overview**
------------

Your next great move.

If you're passionate about staying ahead of the curve in cybersecurity and thrive on helping organizations safeguard their most valuable digital assets, an Account Executive role at Palo Alto Networks could be your next great move. We're looking for individuals who are passionate about advanced security solutions and enjoy tailoring them to meet complex challenges. We're always recruiting the best and brightest who thrive on helping customers navigate the ever-changing security landscape and have the ability to make the most complex challenges attainable. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to evangelize the Palo Alto Networks platform and highlight the benefits it can provide our customers, helping them secure their most critical digital assets. At Palo Alto Networks, you'll find strong career growth, collaboration with top talent, and a mission-driven environment focused on securing our digital future.

* Level: Mid-Senior
* Travel: Yes (frequent)

-------------------

What it takes to be successful.

What makes a successful Major Account Manager at Palo Alto Networks? Check out the top traits we’re looking for and see if you have the right mix.

* Influences
* Focuses on the Customer
* Drives Results
* Technical Acumen
* Sales Hygiene
* Demonstrates Resilience

  

Get the latest details.

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

**Who We Are**

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

**Job Summary**

  
  

* As a Major Account Manager, you will drive and orchestrate large complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer
* Your consultative selling experience will identify business challenges and create solutions for prospects and our customers
* Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the portfolio of Palo Alto Networks solutions
* Create clear goals and complete accurate forecasting through developing a detailed territory plan
* Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
* Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
* Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meetings
  

  

**Qualifications**

* Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security industry
* Demonstrated experience selling complex solutions, value selling, and/or consultative sales techniques
* Technical aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems
* Identifies problems, reviews data, determines the root causes, and provides scalable solutions
* Cultivate relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers
* Demonstrates in depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process
* Ability to take a holistic approach to problem solving by understanding the bigger picture, and considering complex interrelationships and outcomes
* Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus.

$272,000.00 - $374,000.00/yr

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

jobs.title: Trust Operations - Client Services
jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

The Trust Operations Specialist - Client Service answers questions regarding investments in private equity, real estate, private debt, and more. Effectively handles client inquiries by researching and analyzing complex issues. Adheres strictly to trust regulations and security standards including the customer identification program (KYC), the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act, Bank Secrecy Act, Internal Revenue Code, and all other applicable banking and trust regulation set forth by the IRS and other regulatory agencies.

Acts as the face of the company at the frontlines of the customer service experience. Provides superior customer service through an omni-channel environment including chat, written correspondence, incoming calls, outbound calls, and emails to both internal and external parties such as clients, asset sponsors, financial advisors, attorneys, CPAs etc. Represents the company in a highly professional manner while resolving issues and communicating information confidently.

* Use working knowledge of various processes, asset types, and service levels across the firm to quickly analyze the root cause of issues and determine the correct course of action, following up on the item to ensure ultimate resolution.
* Mitigate company risk through following all security and fraud prevention requirements.
* Educate advisors, clients, and third parties on do’s and don'ts of alternative asset investing, working with the Company, applicable fees & fee schedules, timelines and procedures for account opening, funding and investing, and ERISA guidelines.
* Prepare and archive professional correspondence.
* Investigate account issues by analyzing investment and transactional activity and/or errors; complex compliance issues pertaining to IRS rules and regulations
* Identify, analyze, resolve and report on specific client requests and issues.
* Develop expertise to provide clients on-going support and assistance.
* Manage low level escalations, including ability to draft free form professional responses to client escalations and inquiries.
* Identify, recommend and potentially design and assist in the development and implementation of process improvements that enhance the client experience.
* Accurately file reports on client issues for management review.
* Analyze trends in client issues in order to facilitate service improvement.
* Other duties as assigned.

**About You:**

* H.S. Diploma/GED required.
* Bachelor's Degree preferred.
* 2+ years' experience in a customer success role involving highly detailed transactions required.
* 1-2 years' experience in a fast-paced call center environment preferred.
* Working knowledge of trust accounting systems, IRAs, and Alternative Assets is preferred.
* Certified IRA Services Professional (CISP) designation with the American Bankers Association (ABA) preferred.
* Self-Directed IRA Professional (SDIP) designation from the Retirement Industry Trust Association (RITA) preferred.
* Proficient in IRC 4975, prohibited transactions and all other ERISA guidelines.
* Proficient in IRS publication 590 and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Knowledge of operational procedures, practices and policies.
* Demonstrates the ability to sell Bank products and services.
* Able to mentor new associates through on the job training.
* Requires the ability to multi-task and work with over 25 software applications.
* Requires intermediate computer skills, including MS Office and banking software.
* Skill in basic troubleshooting: mobile devices, browsers, and other technology as it relates to online banking.
* Thorough understanding of products and services offered by bank. Advanced knowledge in specialty area.
* Excellent customer service skills and ability to work effectively with the public.

The pay range for this role is $25.00 to $34.00.

The pay rate for the selected candidate is dependent upon a variety of non-discriminatory factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, education, and geographic location. The role may be eligible for performance-based incentive compensation, and those details will be provided during the recruitment process.

**Primary Location:** Ability to work fully onsite at posted location(s).

1045 W Katella Avenue Suite 100 Orange CA 92867  
  

**Our Benefits:**

  

We are proud to offer a competitive total rewards package including base wages and comprehensive benefits.

We offer eligible associates comprehensive healthcare coverage (medical, dental, and vision plans), a 401(k)-retirement savings plan with employer match for qualifying associate contributions, an employee assistance program, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition assistance, mental health resources, identity theft protection, legal support, auto and home insurance, pet insurance, access to an online discount marketplace, and paid vacation, sick days, volunteer days, and holidays. Benefit eligibility begins the first day of the month following the date of hire for associates who are regularly scheduled to work at least thirty hours weekly.

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity:**

  

Columbia Bank is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to employing, engaging, and developing a diverse workforce. An ABM Onsite Service Assistant Project Manager - Janitorial for the Sports & Entertainment Vertical Market is responsible for the operational and financial success of his/her project. * Ensure department training programs and recertification programs are being conducted within appropriate timeframes.

* Performs other duties as assigned or requested.

* One to three years of facilities management experience is preferred.
* Bilingual (English and Spanish) preferred.
* Ability to work night shift.
* Ability to adjust work schedule as needed to support the operation.
* Ability to effectively lead a staff of direct reports.
* Ability to effectively communicate and to read and interpret documents including safety rules, operating and procedural manuals, and handbooks.
* Basic understanding of computer programs, including Microsoft Office.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced work environment.
* Ability to resolve issues under tight timeframes and pressure.
* Ability to prioritize assignments and projects and to multi-task within restricted time constraints.
* Excellent team building and planning skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills; ability to develop productive business relationships, and ability to influence and educate employees.

Committed to creating smarter, more connected spaces, ABM is investing in the future to meet evolving challenges and build a healthier, thriving world. ABM: Driving possibility, together.

We will provide you with assistance and make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.

  

ABM participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program. E-Verify is an internet-based system used to electronically confirm employment eligibility.

jobs.description:
**Updated:** Yesterday  
**Location:** Santa Monica, CA, United States  
**Job ID:** 18722-OTHLOC-C5xvYfwP

Not ready to apply?  
Join our Talent Network

**Description**

The Cardiovascular Sales Representative (CSR) is responsible for achieving or exceeding sales goals within an assigned geography while operating in a compliant and ethical manner. This role develops and executes territory strategies, identifies customer needs, and drives results. Using strong analytical skills, the CSR evaluates regional market data to build and implement strategic territory business plans, foster lasting professional relationships, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners. The ideal candidate has strong business acumen, is resourceful, self-motivated, results-oriented, and collaborative.

**Responsibilities**

* Achieve and/or exceed targeted sales goals in an assigned territory by developing, implementing and executing an integrated territory business plan encompassing key customers and accounts with the goal of maximizing sales.
* Establish and maintain professional relationships with targeted physicians to maximize new business opportunities.
* Achieve success in a complex, matrixed selling environment in which the need for collaboration and cross-functional discipline is critical. Cross-functional partners may consist of FRMs, TLLs, Market Access, Medical, Marketing and Operations colleagues.
* Identify key influencers and achieve designated customer interaction expectations with a focus on top target customers.
* Use data tools and insights, and other informational sources such as next best action, to determine strategies and tactics for business decision-making.
* Demonstrate account-based selling skills (including group presentations, etc.).
* Plan and organize activities to ensure regular and consistent coverage of the territory according to a plan of action.
* Manage territory budget to support sales and marketing activities.
* Complete all administrative tasks in a timely manner.
* Execute the company’s brand strategy and tactics within their assigned geographic area.
* Participation in training and development programs.
* Comply with all legal, regulatory and compliance policies and demonstrate a high level of integrity and professionalism at all times.
* Additional duties as required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Life Sciences, Business or a related field required.
* 3+ years of pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical sales experience.
* 2+ years of cardiovascular/cardiometabolic strongly preferred.
* Experience in highly managed, payor-controlled markets is strongly preferred.
* Consistent track record of documented top-tier sales accomplishments.
* Experience calling on assigned targets in the designated territory geography highly desired.
* Experience launching products in competitive marketplace.
* Ability to learn complex scientific information, apply technical proficiency and effectively communicate.
* Must be self-motivated and able to work with a high level of autonomy and independence.
* Strong technical & analytical skills including proficiency with CRM, AI tools and Microsoft Office Suite.
* A valid driver’s license and ability to travel as needed, which may include overnight and/or weekend travel.

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $120,000 to $130,000. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.

At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Our ability to collaborate and problem-solve makes a difference in patients’ lives daily. By joining one of our account management teams, you will partner with industry experts and be empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy needed to successfully navigate the complex market access landscape. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Join our game-changing, global company dedicated to creating better, smarter, faster ways to get biopharmaceutical therapies to patients Experience the thrill of knowing that your everyday efforts are contributing to improving patients’ lives around the world.

Work Here Matters Everywhere | How are you inspired to change lives?

*Syneos Health companies are affirmative action/equal opportunity employers (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

At Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position will include a competitive compensation package, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos Health complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

--------------------

As the public voice and real-time managing editor for our brands, you will own our community engagement strategy across all social platforms. This is a highly autonomous role where you will apply your deep knowledge of platform culture and algorithms to independently make strategic and editorial judgments on copy, public engagement, and trend response without routine managerial sign-off. Your mission is to protect and nurture our brand reputation while translating cultural trends into strategic opportunities.

* Act as the primary cultural sensor for the brand, mining platform, audience, and cultural (PAC) signals to determine which trends and conversations warrant action.

* Monitor and interpret consumer conversations, comments, and sentiment to identify strategic patterns and creative opportunities.
* Analyze in-market social creative and provide real-time optimization recommendations to internal and external partners.
* Use social listening and data tools to synthesize consumer insights that inform future creative development and campaign direction.
* Maintain platform hygiene through diligent sentiment monitoring, community moderation, and strategic escalation to protect brand reputation.

**What are your skills and experience?**

* Deep, native expertise in the algorithms, trend cycles, and content formats of key social platforms (e.g., TikTok, Instagram, YouTube).
* Professional experience in social media strategy, creative strategy, or digital marketing, preferably within a fast-paced agency or consumer brand environment.
* Proven ability to partner with video editors and creators to quickly develop and refine social-first content based on real-time performance.
* A strong editorial eye and the ability to make autonomous, high-stakes judgment calls on brand voice and public response.
* A demonstrated history of identifying emerging cultural trends and translating them into successful, brand-aligned creative concepts

*#LI-Hybrid #LI-HM1*

jobs.description:
About Barabas

Barabas is a Los Angeles-based, fashion-forward menswear brand that views clothing as a powerful form of self-expression. Our collections combine sophisticated staples with bold, statement-making designs created for men who want to stand out with confidence and individuality.

We place a strong emphasis on fit, quality, innovation, and originality, using distinctive fabrics, finishes, patterns, and silhouettes to create memorable fashion. From elevated essentials to trend-driven statement pieces, Barabas delivers contemporary menswear designed to make an impact.

As we continue to grow our brand and expand our digital presence, we are looking for a talented **Photographer, Videographer & Social Media Manager** to join our creative team in Los Angeles.

This is a **hybrid creative role combining three key functions: Photography, Videography, and Social Media Management.**

We are looking for a highly creative and digitally focused individual who can take ownership of the visual content process from **concept development and production to editing, publishing, and social media execution**.

* Collaborate with marketing, merchandising, e-commerce, and creative teams.
* Stay current with fashion, photography, videography, social media, AI, and digital content trends.

* Strong understanding of fashion photography, composition, lighting, framing, and visual storytelling.
* Experience shooting apparel and fashion products in studio and lifestyle environments.
* Strong videography skills, including camera operation, framing, movement, lighting, and basic audio capture.
* Experience managing social media content for a brand, business, fashion company, or similar organization.

jobs.title: Outside Sales Representative - Digital Marketing
jobs.description:
**What We Offer**

Commission-only, no base - Just close 4 deals per month to earn $170,000+/ year OTE. After 12 months estimated $26,400+/m recurring monthly.

Uncapped earnings based on sales commissions. Car allowance provided. No base salary offered at this time.

**About IOI Solutions**

We are an elite Automotive Marketing agency in Los Angeles. We help high-end automotive shops attract customers and scale up their revenue with our digital marketing services. Auto shops choose IOI for our goal-obsessed approach, transparent measurement of revenue, and proven track-record of success. We're also uniquely Automotive only.

We work with Auto Body shops, Detailers, Car Dealerships, PPF shops, Vehicle Wraps, Window Tints, Clubs and events, and more.

**Role Summary**

The **Outside Sales Representative Role** is key for attracting high-value business owners to become clients at IOI. The objective is to meet with new prospects and close deals. You will be working alongside founder of IOI, hitting the pavement together to build up the initial sales momentum.

You will meet with managers, owners, and decision makers, building rapport and asking discovery questions to position IOI as excellent value to the business. You will have all necessary training, insights, and sales materials to close deals.

From these visits you will own the sales process until the client closes into booked revenue. Keeping tracking CRM notes and follow up meetings. Once client closes into booked revenue, you will be paid commission.

Outside of visiting local shops, if interested, you may do conferences and networking meetups as part of out outbound efforts to meet with top clientele. You will work closely with IOI's leadership team on which shops to focus on, sales strategy, proposals, positioning, and closing.

**Your Experience & Background**

* College Degree preferred or 3+ years high-ticket sales experience
* Proven experience closing deals, ideally at least $30,000 in contract value.
* Based in Los Angeles with Reliable transportation

**Capabilities:**

* **Executive Communication:** Clear, confident communicator who can translate performance into business impact.
* **Growth Mindset:** Continuously seeks better ways to close more deals.
* **Physical:** Comfortable spending a significant portion of the workday traveling throughout Los Angeles
* **Confidence:** Comfortable walking into businesses without an appointment and asking for the owner.
* **Organized:** Self-directed and capable of planning day based on current sales pipeline and responding to client messages to drive appointments.

**Success Metrics**

* 4 New Clients Per Month
* 5-10 New Prospects Met Per Day
* Total booking value

Uncapped earnings, so if you close more deals or higher contract values, you earn more.

**Who You Are**

* Competitive, ambitious, and highly motivated by performance-based compensation
* Excellent relationship building and interpersonal skills
* Strong sales instincts and ability to move conversations toward a decision
* Persistent and comfortable following up repeatedly without becoming discouraged by rejection
* Self-directed and capable of managing your own territory and daily activity

**Bonus Qualifications**

* Experience with Automotive such as Car Dealership sales.
* Experience in outbound sales, outside sales, field sales, business development.
* Certifications from Jeremy Miner or any notable sales trainer.

**Culture & Fit Traits**

* **Trusted Advisor Mentality:** Builds durable client relationships grounded in integrity and impact.
* **Client-Obsessed:** Prioritizes client outcomes and long-term partnership value.
* **Collaborative:** Works seamlessly across teams and disciplines.
* **Resilient & Adaptable:** Thrives in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.
* **IOI DNA:** Operates with precision, ownership, and a bias toward action.

Pay: $120,000.00 - $300,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Industry:** Licensed Cannabis  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

About the Role

We are a licensed California cannabis brand looking for a motivated, relationship-driven **Outside Sales Representative** to grow our retail presence across the **Los Angeles and Inland Empire markets**.

This is a field-based sales role focused on developing relationships with licensed cannabis dispensaries, introducing our products to buyers and purchasing teams, growing existing accounts, and driving consistent sell-through.

The ideal candidate knows the California cannabis retail landscape, is comfortable walking into dispensaries and meeting decision-makers, and understands that successful cannabis sales are built on **relationships, follow-through, product knowledge, and consistent account management**.

Responsibilities

* Identify and develop relationships with licensed cannabis dispensaries throughout LA and the Inland Empire
* Prospect new retail accounts through in-person visits, phone, email, and industry networking
* Build relationships with dispensary owners, buyers, purchasing managers, and retail teams
* Present our brand, products, pricing, promotions, and wholesale programs to prospective accounts
* Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting and product presentation through order placement and follow-up
* Grow sales within existing accounts through regular store visits and relationship management
* Monitor inventory, pricing, promotions, and product placement at retail accounts
* Work with dispensary teams to identify opportunities to increase product visibility and sell-through
* Maintain accurate records of prospects, accounts, orders, and sales activity
* Stay informed on California cannabis regulations, market trends, competitive products, and retail dynamics
* Represent the brand professionally at dispensary visits, industry events, and other business-development opportunities
* Meet or exceed established sales and account-growth goals

What We're Looking For

* Proven outside sales experience; cannabis industry experience strongly preferred
* Existing relationships with California cannabis dispensaries and/or buyers is a major plus
* Strong understanding of the LA and/or Inland Empire cannabis retail market
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
* Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a field-sales environment
* Highly organized with strong follow-up and account-management skills

The Clinical Research Coordinator will work closely with Principal Investigators, Sub-Investigators, sponsors, CROs, and the clinical operations team to ensure the successful execution of clinical research protocols. This is a hands-on, patient-facing position requiring strong clinical skills, attention to detail, excellent communication, and the ability to manage multiple study activities in a fast-paced environment.

The ideal candidate is passionate about clinical research and patient care, is comfortable interacting with study participants, and can independently perform clinical procedures while maintaining strict adherence to study protocols, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), and applicable regulatory requirements.

Responsibilities

* Assist with sponsor monitoring visits, audits, inspections, and other study-related activities.
* Track recruitment, screening, enrollment, retention, and study milestones.
* Educate participants regarding study procedures, visit requirements, medication administration, and study expectations.
* Maintain participant confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and applicable privacy requirements.
* Ensure all study activities are performed in accordance with the protocol, GCP, SOPs, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate with the clinical team to provide a positive, professional, and patient-centered research experience.

Required Qualifications

* **Current Phlebotomy Certification - REQUIRED.**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple studies and competing priorities.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with investigators and the broader research team.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, patient-facing clinical environment.
* Proficiency with electronic medical records and/or electronic clinical research systems.
* Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and handle sensitive health information appropriately.

* Equivalent clinical research or healthcare experience may be considered.

Preferred Experience

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
**About Crossing Inc**

Crossing is a fast-growing e-commerce, retail, and collectibles company serving passionate communities across trading cards, gaming, anime, and pop culture. Through our retail stores, live commerce channels, events, and online platforms, we're building one of the most exciting destinations for collectors and enthusiasts.

**About the role**

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and proactive Executive Assistant/Office Assistant to provide administrative and operational support to our leadership team and assist with the day to day functions of our growing collectibles company.

The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail oriented, professional, and comfortable handling a variety of responsibilities ranging from executive assistance and administrative support to general office organization and supply management.

**What you'll do**

### **Executive, Leadership & Administrative Support**

* Provide day-to-day administrative support to the VP of Operations and other members of the executive and leadership team.
* Manage calendars, appointments, meetings, reminders, and scheduling.
* Coordinate internal and external meetings and assist with meeting preparation and follow-up.
* Draft, review, and organize emails, correspondence, documents, spreadsheets, reports, and other business materials.
* Assist with travel arrangements, reservations, itineraries, and other executive needs.
* Track important deadlines, projects, follow-ups, and action items to help keep priorities moving forward.
* Assist leadership with special projects, company initiatives, and changing business priorities.
* Handle confidential company, employee, financial, and business information with a high level of discretion.

### **Office Operations & Workspace Support**

* Help oversee the daily organization and general operations of the office.
* Maintain a clean, organized, professional, and well-stocked workplace.
* Monitor and order office supplies and other workplace necessities.
* Maintain inventory of office and workplace supplies and proactively reorder items before supplies run out.
* Receive, organize, and distribute mail, deliveries, and packages.
* Coordinate with vendors, maintenance providers, delivery services, and other outside partners.
* Assist with keeping common areas, conference rooms, kitchen areas, and office spaces organized and properly supplied.
* Answer and direct phone calls, emails, and general business inquiries when necessary.

**Collectibles and Inventory Support**

* Assist with organizing and maintaining inventory records.
* Support with the organization of products
* Help prepare merchandise, supplies and materials for shows, events and store openings.

**Qualifications**

* 1-2 years experience as an Executive Assistant, Administrative Assistant, Office Assistant, Office Coordinator, or similar position preferred.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and adjust to changing business needs.
* Willingness to assist wherever needed and take ownership of both large and small tasks.
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating with executives, managers, HR and other employees.
* Professional demeanor and strong interpersonal skills.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace.
* Comfortable learning inventory and other business software.

  
**The pay range for this role is:**  
25 - 30 USD per hour(Irvine, CA)

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
We are expanding and looking for an **organized, proactive, bilingual Administrative Coordinator** to join our growing team in California.  
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, coordinating teams, solving problems, and helping create an exceptional patient experience.  
We are especially interested in candidates who have experience in healthcare or medical administration; however, **medical experience is preferred but not required**. We are willing to consider candidates with strong administrative, leadership, customer service, or operations experience who have the right skills, attitude, and willingness to learn.  
**Compensation is open for discussion and will be based on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and overall fit for the position.**

*What You’ll Do*

* Coordinate administrative activities and support the day-to-day operations of the clinic.
* Help organize staff and ensure daily operational needs are addressed.
* Serve as a liaison between staff, management, the Medical Director, and other departments.
* Support hiring, onboarding, training, payroll, accreditation, and staff development.
* Assist with scheduling and coordinating staff to support daily clinic operations.
* Provide guidance and support to team members regarding company policies, attendance, performance, and workplace expectations.
* Help create a positive, professional, and collaborative work environment.
* Identify operational challenges and proactively help develop solutions.
* Maintain effective working relationships with staff, leadership, and patients.
* Help ensure an exceptional patient experience throughout the patient journey.
* Support administrative projects and initiatives as needed.

*What We’re Looking For*  
We are looking for someone who is **professional, dependable, organized, proactive, and genuinely enjoys working with people.**  
Qualifications

* Minimum of **2 years of experience in an administrative, coordination, supervisory, customer service, healthcare, or similar role**.
* **Fluent in English and Spanish – required.**
* Healthcare or medical office experience is **preferred**.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach.
* Ability to work independently while being a strong team player.
* Professionalism, discretion, integrity, and a strong sense of responsibility.
* Willingness to learn healthcare-specific processes, compliance requirements, and company procedures.

**Certified Medical Administrative Assistant certification is a plus, but not required.**  
The Right Person for This Role  
We are looking for someone who:

* Takes initiative and doesn't wait to be asked what needs to be done.
* Enjoys helping others and supporting a team.
* Communicates clearly and respectfully.
* Is organized and detail-oriented.
* Has a positive, solutions-focused attitude.
* Understands the importance of providing an excellent patient experience.
* Is comfortable working in a growing and changing environment.
* Is eager to learn and grow professionally.

**Compensation:** **$60,000 annually, with flexibility based on experience, qualifications, and overall fit.**  
We are open to discussing compensation with the right candidate and encourage qualified applicants with strong experience to apply.  
Benefits

* Full-time position
* Competitive compensation based on experience
* Paid time off
* 10 vacation days after one year of employment
* 5 paid sick days after 90 days
* Paid holidays
* Long-term career opportunity
* Supportive and collaborative work environment
* Opportunity for professional growth within a growing organization

We Want to Meet You!  
If you are bilingual, organized, motivated, and looking for an opportunity to grow with a company, **we encourage you to apply—even if your background is not exclusively in healthcare.**  
We value **experience, attitude, leadership, integrity, and the ability to learn** just as much as industry-specific experience.  
If you believe you have the skills and personality to make a positive impact on our team, **we would love to hear from you.**  
**Apply today and tell us why you would be a great addition to our team!**

Pay: $60,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person
