jobs.title: Enterprise Account Manager, East Coast US (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
**\*\*This position is based in either New York, Chicago or Boston within a (max) 2 hour commute to allow for in-person meetings, and has remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.\*\***

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaos’ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. For more information, please visit chaos.com.

**Role Overview**

The **Enterprise Account Manager** is an individual contributor responsible for driving revenue growth within a dedicated portfolio of high-potential enterprise accounts across the AEC sector. The role focuses on expanding Chaos’s footprint within existing accounts through strategic upsell, cross-sell, and solution adoption, while building deep, long-term relationships with senior client stakeholders. Working as part of the global enterprise sales team and reporting to the VP of Sales, this role contributes directly to ARR growth targets through disciplined pipeline management and the execution of complex, high-value expansion deals. This role requires a commercially sharp enterprise sales professional with a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Owns the end-to-end growth strategy for a select portfolio of high-potential AEC accounts (characterized by low current penetration relative to their potential spend).
* Develop and execute plans to maximize ARR through strategic upsell, cross-sell, and solution adoption.
* Cultivates and expands relationships with senior-level stakeholders and decision-makers within assigned accounts globally, aligning Chaos solutions with their core business objectives and long-term strategic vision.
* Creates and presents compelling ROI and business value analyses to justify significant new investments in the Chaos ecosystem, focusing on demonstrating measurable impact on the client's AEC workflows.
* Leads the negotiation and closing of complex, multi-year expansion deals globally, navigating diverse procurement and legal processes unique to large AEC firms.
* Identifies opportunities for workflow transformation within client organizations, positioning Chaos as integral to their design and visualization processes.
* Develops and manages a robust, long-term sales pipeline for the assigned portfolio, providing accurate and reliable forecasting for expansion revenue.
* Maintains expertise on global AEC industry trends, digital transformation initiatives, competitive landscapes, and client innovation priorities to proactively identify and seize growth opportunities.

**Required Experience**

* At least 5 years of experience in enterprise sales, strategic account management, or business development
* Demonstrated track record of consistently exceeding expansion and net-new revenue targets in a complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales environment: able to speak to the numbers, what was planned, and what was delivered.
* Proven experience managing and growing a portfolio of large enterprise accounts, with clear ownership of upsell and cross-sell outcomes across long sales cycles.
* Experience negotiating and closing complex, multi-year enterprise contracts, including development of executive-level business cases demonstrating TCO and ROI.

**Required Skills**

* Navigates complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals with commercial sharpness and discipline: manages long sales cycles without losing momentum, and closes with consistency.
* Builds credible, trusted relationships with C-level and senior executive stakeholders, engaging at the level of business strategy rather than product features.
* Develops rigorous account plans and pipeline strategies, using data and account intelligence to identify where to invest time and where to expand coverage.
* Creates commercial momentum proactively, surfaces new expansion opportunities and builds pipeline rather than waiting for demand to appear.
* Applies intellectual curiosity and second-order thinking to get beneath the surface of a client's needs, uncovering the true business pain points that shape a winning solution.
* Translates complex technical capabilities into clear business value narratives that resonate with both technical users and executive decision-makers.
* Operates with a high degree of autonomy and self-discipline: manages territory, pipeline, and stakeholder relationships without close oversight
* Reads sales data, pipeline metrics, and market signals accurately, and uses that intelligence to prioritise effort and inform forecasting.
* Fluency in English is required.

We welcome people who value teamwork, stick to their commitments and are curious to explore new ways for achieving mastery. If you believe that you are a good match for the job, just send us your CV in **English**.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Confidentiality of all applications is assured.

jobs.title: New PSA Service Sales Representative-Fire
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

**PSA Service Sales Representative**
------------------------------------

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we help elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and move society forward.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

We are seeking a Service Sales Representative to promote and sell service agreements for commercial building systems products, including fire alarm, suppression, sprinkler, security, sound, communication, and inspections. In this role, you will build customer relationships, develop opportunities, and support the sales process from prospecting through contract close and ongoing account service.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Promote and sell service agreements for commercial building systems to an assigned customer base.
* Establish contact with prospects, qualify potential buyers, and follow up on leads using planned sales activities and marketing strategies.
* Develop a positive ongoing relationship with customers to understand needs and support long-term retention.
* Create sales strategies that align Johnson Controls service offerings with customer requirements and decision drivers.
* Close sufficient sales to meet sales plan objectives and maintain an active proposal backlog.
* Conduct building surveys to support estimate development and proposal accuracy.
* Maintain accurate and complete records of all sales-related activities.
* Submit sales reports, expenses, competitive activity, and correspondence accurately and on time.
* Support the service department by generating leads for service or equipment and device upgrades.
* Collaborate with service, technical, design engineering, support, and management teams to deliver a strong customer experience.

**How You Will Do It**
----------------------

  

* You will work with discipline and accountability by managing your pipeline, following through on commitments, and keeping records, reporting, and customer communication current.
* You will stay close to the customer’s work by listening carefully, conducting building surveys, and aligning service solutions to real operational needs.
* You will prospect with consistency by scheduling sales calls, following up on leads, and using approved marketing strategies to uncover new opportunities.
* You will improve outcomes through candor and problem-solving by reviewing competitive activity, refining your approach, and identifying service or upgrade opportunities.
* You will win as one team by working closely with internal partners to remove obstacles for customers and support long-term service success.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Degree or equivalent work experience, typically 5 years.
* At least 5 years of B2B sales experience with a proven track record.
* Experience selling a service, intangible, or technical product.
* Experience prospecting, qualifying, solution selling, and closing deals.
* Ability to work in a matrix environment with minimal direction and meet quota-based performance expectations.
* Strong professional communication, interpersonal, and time management skills.
* Proficiency with personal computers, including Windows and Oracle systems.
* Ability and willingness to work as a teammate and collaborate well with others.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Bachelor’s degree in a technical or business discipline.
* Experience in the industry or a related industry.
* Salesforce proficiency.

**Why Join Us**
---------------

We offer a competitive salary, 15 days of vacation in the first year, and a comprehensive benefits package including 401(k), medical, dental, and vision care available day one. You’ll also find an encouraging and collaborative team environment, dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy, and on-the-job and cross-training opportunities that support your growth.

If you are ready to build trusted customer relationships and help grow service solutions for commercial building systems, we’d love to hear from you.

**HIRING SALARY RANGE: $ 55k- $72K** (Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data.) **This role also offers a competitive Sales Incentive Plan that will take into account volume and margin on a project, quarterly, and annual basis**. This position includes a competitive benefits package. The posted salary range reflects the target compensation for this role. However, we recognize that exceptional candidates may bring unique skills and experiences that exceed the typical profile. **If you believe your background warrants consideration beyond the stated range, we encourage you to apply.** To support an efficient and fair hiring process, we may use technology assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to help identify and evaluate candidates. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by human reviewers. For details, please visit the About Us tab on the Johnson Controls Careers site at https://jobs.johnsoncontrols.com/about-us

jobs.title: Manager, Sales Operations (Food Services)
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**  
Manager, Sales Operations (Food Services)
  
  
Role Summary
  
The Manager, Sales Operations, Away From Home leads critical sales communication, field engagement, commercial technology, and merchandising support capabilities for the Foodservice sales organization. This role keeps cross-functional teams informed and aligned, ensures sales support platforms effectively meet commercial needs, and manages the resources and processes that enable consistent field execution.
  
The manager serves as a central connection point across Sales, Marketing, Trade, Supply Chain, Finance, Customer Service, IT, external vendors, and technology partners.
  
  
Top Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead sales communications and field engagement

Develop and execute a comprehensive communication strategy that keeps the Foodservice sales organization informed, aligned, and focused on execution priorities. Lead bi-weekly sales update calls and manage recurring field communications, including “What’s New” updates and newsletters.
  

* Develop leadership and sales meeting content

Create meeting agendas, presentations, and action-item follow-up for field communication meetings. Support leadership presentations and sales meeting content development while maintaining communication calendars and execution timelines.
  

* Coordinate cross-functional commercial updates and calendarization

Consolidate information from Sales, Marketing, Trade, Supply Chain, Finance, and Customer Service. Ensure consistent communication of sales initiatives, product launches, programs, priorities, and process changes across the organization.
  

* Own sales support technology and platform strategy

Serve as the business owner for commercial technology and sales support platforms. Develop technology roadmaps, prioritize enhancements and issue resolution, facilitate requirements gathering and testing, and monitor platform adoption, utilization, and effectiveness. Platform responsibilities include Telus email functionality, Scanbuy, Nvision, reporting and analytics tools, sample management platforms, and future sales enablement and AI solutions.
  

* Manage technology and vendor partnerships

Build productive relationships with technology providers and external vendors. Partner with IT on integrations, upgrades, governance, user access, and system support. Vendor relationships include Racks Inc., Great Northern, Siffron, and Kubik.
  

* Lead merchandiser program administration

Create, maintain, and track Foodservice merchandiser resources. Manage field assignments, deployment processes, sales team requests, activity reporting, and communication. Monitor utilization and execution effectiveness while supporting annual planning and budgeting for merchandising initiatives.
  
  
Qualifications
  
Must-Have Qualifications.
  
  

* Demonstrated experience in sales operations, commercial enablement, field communications, technology ownership, or a related business function.
* Strong written, verbal, presentation, and meeting-facilitation skills, with the ability to translate cross-functional information into clear, actionable sales communications.
* Experience gathering business requirements, prioritizing technology enhancements, coordinating user testing, and partnering with IT or technology vendors.
* Experience supporting Foodservice, Away From Home, consumer packaged goods, or another field-based selling organization.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, communications, marketing, sales operations, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience
* Experience managing merchandising programs, external vendors, budgets, or field resource deployment.
* Familiarity with sales enablement, reporting and analytics, QR-code solutions, sample management platforms, SharePoint, or emerging AI-enabled commercial tools.

Key Capabilities for Success
  
  

* Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management
* Commercial communication and executive storytelling
* Technology roadmap and platform ownership
* Vendor and partner management
* Project management and implementation discipline
* Analytical thinking and adoption measurement
* Continuous improvement and field-service orientation

The base pay range for this position at commencement of employment is between the range listed below, however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position will include variable pay, medical and dental benefits, participation in 401k plan, and paid time off benefits. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, Large Enterprise
jobs.description:
**About the role and team**  
  
Working as a Customer Success Manager at Uber means moving beyond the polished surface of account management to solve the complex, high-stakes operational realities our largest enterprise partners face every day. You will be the bridge between our digital platform and the physical storefronts of our most important enterprise partners, ensuring that Uber remains their preferred delivery engine through relentless analytical rigor and hands-on problem solving.  
  
The pace is intense and the environment is frequently ambiguous, requiring a mindset that thrives when there is no established playbook. This role is for those who take extreme ownership of partner outcomes, possess the grit to navigate internal friction, and are energized by the challenge of turning complex data into real-world marketplace reliability. If you prefer a predictable, transactional routine over the rewarding but demanding work of scaling global partnerships, this may not be the right fit for you.  
  
**What you'll do**

* Build and grow long-term partnerships by deeply understanding what matters most to our enterprise customers, moving beyond simple product support to deliver tangible business value.
* Navigate internal complexity and cross-functional tension to advocate for product enhancements and unblock operational bottlenecks for your partners.
* Solve messy, high-impact problems using data-driven insights to identify patterns that impact experience at scale.
* Adapt your strategy based on shifting market dynamics and imperfect information to ensure partners see consistent ROI and platform reliability.
* Champion operational excellence by identifying and reducing "operational debt" while maintaining a high quality bar for your portfolio.
* Lead cross-functional collaborations with operations, product, and legal teams to shape and deliver solutions that scale.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years of client-facing experience in account management, customer success, or consulting.
* Proficiency in data analysis and using Excel to drive business judgment and decision-making.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency in SQL to independently extract insights from large-scale datasets.
* Experience managing stakeholders across diverse business functions and levels.
* Demonstrated systems thinking with the ability to turn unstructured, ambiguous problems into focused execution plans.
* Experience in the technology or food delivery industry managing high-pressure projects.
* Proven ability to influence without authority and navigate complex interpersonal dynamics.

  
For Chicago, IL-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $107,000 per year - USD $119,000 per year.  
  
For Dallas, TX-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $107,000 per year - USD $119,000 per year.  
  
For Miami, FL-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $107,000 per year - USD $119,000 per year.  
  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $119,000 per year - USD $132,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $119,000 per year - USD $132,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Digital Marketing/Advertising)
jobs.description:
**Why Join Our Team?**

When joining Leap Group, you're joining a team that is passionate, innovative, and connected. Some words we've heard our teammates use to describe our culture are welcoming, collaborative, flexible, and dog-friendly (warning: your interview may be accompanied by a wagging tail)

We give our team the ability to make an impact with clients, while expanding their experience and depth of knowledge in the process. We like to show our appreciation for everything our teammates do by offering supportive and inclusive benefits that allow them to thrive. This includes things like:

Health, dental, vision, and ancillary benefits

Paid maternity and paternity leave

Unlimited PTO and Summer Fridays

Autonomy and flexibility

Company-paid access to coaching and therapy

401k plan with match and 1:1 access to investment advisor

Professional development opportunities

Remote-hybrid flexibility

**Diverse and Inclusive Marketing Comes from Diverse and Inclusive Teams**

We recognize our teammates are our greatest assets in helping our clients market less and matter more. Diverse backgrounds, opinions and perspectives on our team allow us to expand our own perspectives and, in the process, create solutions that are innovative, creative, and strategic.

We're constantly working to transform our agencies and industry into spaces that are more diverse, equitable, and inclusive, and we welcome the addition of YOUR unique voice and perspective. Don't forget to ask us about our focus on diversity, equity, and inclusion during your interview.

**Accommodation Requests**

Leap Group complies with the ADA and ADAAA. If you need reasonable accommodation to apply, interview, or do the job, please include your accommodate request in the corresponding application question.

**Where is This Role?**

While we service clients nationally and internationally, Leap Group has a footprint in the Midwest, with offices in:

Louisville, KY

Cincinnati, OH

Indianapolis, IN

Chicago, IL

Our roles are typically open to remote candidates located and authorized to work in the U.S. However, strong preference is always given to candidates in or near our physical footprint. This is because we’ve found the ability to seamlessly collaborate in-person is very valuable to the nature of our work.

Regardless of location, onsite time and periodic travel for things like client meetings, collab sessions, production work, pitches, and team gatherings is important and expected. Our hybrid work model is core to how we deliver impact.

**Check Us Out**

To learn more about our agencies and work, visit www.leapgroupnetwork.com

**Who is the Project Manager?**

The Project Manager is a highly organized and proactive operational leader who helps drive the successful delivery of integrated client work across cross-functional teams. This person brings a balance of structure, adaptability, and communication skills, keeping projects moving efficiently while creating clarity and alignment for both internal teams and clients.

In this role, you’ll lead day-to-day project execution across multiple initiatives, with a primary focus on media and creative work. You’ll partner closely with media, creative, strategy and account teams to ensure work is delivered on time, on budget, and at a high standard. You’re solutions-oriented, detail-focused, and energized by bringing order to fast-moving environments with shifting priorities and competing deadlines.

The ideal candidate brings strong project management fundamentals, excellent communication skills, and previous experience working within a marketing or advertising agency. Experience project managing media work is required, with experience managing the creative components of media campaigns also welcomed.

This is a freelance opportunity for approximately 10–20 hours per week. Availability Monday through Friday during standard business hours is important to check in with the team, attend scheduled calls, and keep work moving.

In this role, you can expect to:

* Lead day-to-day management of media and creative client projects across multiple teams and disciplines.
* Build and maintain project timelines, schedules, documentation, and workflows to support efficient delivery.
* Partner with media, creative, strategy and account to keep work moving smoothly from kickoff through final delivery.
* Facilitate kickoff meetings, status meetings, milestone reviews, and project recaps to maintain alignment and accountability.
* Monitor project timelines, budgets, scopes, and deliverables while proactively identifying risks, blockers, or changes in priorities.
* Communicate project status, next steps, dependencies, and expectations clearly with both internal teams and clients.
* Support project scoping, intake, estimation, and resource planning efforts for new and existing client work.
* Help ensure deliverables meet quality standards and client expectations before launch or final delivery.
* Maintain organized and accurate project documentation, including timelines, approvals, financial tracking, and status reporting.
* Contribute to operational improvements by identifying opportunities for more efficient workflows, communication, and project processes.
* Collaborate effectively across teams while helping create a positive, accountable, and solutions-focused working environment.

**What do You Need?**

  

* 3+ years of project management experience in an agency, marketing, digital, creative, or related environment required
* Experience managing media projects, including paid media campaigns and/or supporting creative deliverables, required
* Experience managing multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities and deadlines
* Strong client communication and stakeholder management skills
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams across creative, media, strategy, production, and/or development disciplines
* Experience using project management platforms such as Workfront, Asana, Monda

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Overview:**

As a direct report to the Area Sales Manager, the Business Development Representative will drive the acquisition of new customers and facilitate the expansion of existing accounts within the local market. This role requires a passionate sales professional who excels in identifying and expanding opportunities proactively and cultivating strong, enduring relationships with customers. This role will develop a deep understanding of TrueBlue’s offerings and how we solve customer problems.

**Location:** Bolingbrook, IL

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Actively prospect and acquire new customers within the designated territory through effective networking and lead development.
* Identify growth opportunities and prospects for new customer acquisition.
* Enhance customer loyalty and drive account growth by developing relationships with customers.
* Implement strategic sales initiatives to meet and surpass sales targets.
* Consult with customers to understand their business needs and offer creative solutions to solve workforce needs Effectively sell the PeopleReady service offerings.
* Collaborate with PeopleReady contracts and legal teams to negotiate contract terms effectively.
* Ensure competitive bill rates and margins are applied to all customer contracts.
* Ensure the appropriate branch is aware of any unique, differentiating customer details.
* Proactively solution cross sell opportunities across all TrueBlue brands and neighboring markets.
* Develop account management and sales strategies to increase share of wallet and customer retention.
* Lead formal business reviews with key customers to assess performance and identify growth opportunities.
* Utilize appropriate technology and tools to develop and maintain comprehensive account management and growth strategies.
* Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and market developments to effectively position TrueBlue products/services.
* Mentor other sales reps and client facing employees.

**Education and Experience**

* Three or more years related sales experience; Bachelors, associate degree; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Managed a portfolio of at least $2.5M per annum.
* Sales experience in one or more blue-collar market verticals.
* Proven track record of exceeding sales targets.
* Experience in understanding, adapting, and applying new technologies.
* Valid driver license, registered vehicle, and vehicle insurance.

**Core Knowledge and Skills**

* Communicates clearly, concisely, and professionally in both written and verbal forms
* Adept at persuading diverse customer stakeholders
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail
* Capable of prioritizing tasks and meeting deadlines effectively under pressure
* Analytical abilities: skilled in analyzing order, associate, and customer data to drive informed decisions and achieve outcomes
* Competitive drive
* Capable of establishing rapport with a wide range of individuals
* Understand multiple, diverse perspectives from clients
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite and Salesforce.com, leveraging technology for efficient sales management and reporting

**Work Environment and Physical Demands**

* This role operates with a remote work structure, but it is fundamentally a field-based sales position. The employee will be expected to dedicate over 50% of their time to outside sales activities and client engagement.
* Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, talk, and/or hear for long periods of time. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
* Travel is required as part of the job. Visits to customer sites or local branches required.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* This position will not have any direct supervisory responsibilities.

**Salary Range:** $60,000 - $72,000 annually, depending on experience and geographic location plus eligibility for incentive pay, subject to plan terms. This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation.

Please note that actual compensation offered may vary based on local pay requirements and will meet or exceed state-specific minimum wage or salary thresholds.

**Benefits and Well-Being:**

We offer a competitive benefits package, including 6 paid holidays, 1 paid floating holiday and up to 20 days of Paid Time Off per year, Medical/Dental/Vision insurance, Company-matching 401(k) and Employee Stock Purchase Program, in addition to other programs and perks. More details about our benefits can be found here .

We consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with applicable law.

You must be work authorized in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for employer sponsorship now or in the future. The Company cannot offer employment to F-1 (student) visa holders who require employer sponsorship in the future or cannot work now on a full-time basis.

TrueBlue, Inc. and its brands welcome and encourage applications from candidates with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in the application or interview process. If you require disability-related accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact your Recruiter directly, Employee Relations at HR-Advice@trueblue.com , or 1-800-610-8920. TrueBlue, Inc. and its brands will consult with all applicants who request disability-related accommodation during the application or interview process to ensure that the accommodation provided takes into account the applicant’s individual accessibility needs.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

The Sales Development Representative is responsible for following up on leads and building pipeline for sellers across all of Motorola's North American Government Sales organization. We represent all of Motorola Solution's products and endeavor to help our customers in their quest of "Solving for Safer" by using our end-to-end suite of safety products.

**Job Description**
-------------------

The Sales Development Representative is a key contributor in a rapid growth company while representing a product suite that makes an impact on people's lives. Motorola Solutions is a global leader in public safety and enterprise security. Join our team and help us continue to grow!

  
  

**Responsibilities include:**

* Run call cadences (with support of an automated dialer) to educate our future customers on the value our solutions bring and drive interest in an initial conversation.
* Ask smart, targeted questions to build rapport with our prospects and identify opportunities.
* Focus on targeted outbound list.
* Collaborate with seasoned sales professionals within a territory you support to find, develop and build key stakeholder interest, and crystalize the needs of the organization across multiple customer profiles and buyer groups.
* Re-engage lapsed and long-term leads as we introduce new product features with a focus on bringing them back into the funnel.
* Record prospect interactions and update records within our CRM.
  

  

**Qualifications:**

* Ability to articulate value propositions via phone, video, email, and other various social networking platforms.
* Detail oriented, take exceptional meeting/activity notes, and effective in task and time management.
* Highly motivated, passionate, and results driven.
* Willing and able to contribute to team efforts by accomplishing related tasks as needed.
* Commitment to company vision, mission and values.
  

  

Target Base Salary Range: $48,000 - $52,000 USD

  
  

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.

  
  

#LI-RO1

  

**Basic Requirements**
----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree
* OR 1+ years of sales/customer service experience

**Travel Requirements**
-----------------------

Under 10%

**Relocation Provided**
-----------------------

None

**Position Type**
-----------------

New Grad

**Referral Payment Plan**
-------------------------

Yes

**Our U.S. Benefits include:**

* Incentive Bonus Plans
* Medical, Dental, Vision benefits
* 401K with Company Match
* 10 Paid Holidays
* Generous Paid Time Off Packages
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Paid Parental & Family Leave
* and more!

***EEO Statement***

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

Our family of trusted brands includes Hardie®, TimberTech®, AZEK® Exteriors, Versatex®, fermacell®, and StruXure®.
  
  
With over 8,000 employees and our U.S. operating entities headquartered in Chicago, we boast 31 operating sites, 6 recycling facilities, and 6 research and development centers globally. Powered by a dynamic workforce, we’re united by our purpose of Building a Better Future for All™ through sustainable innovation, a Zero Harm culture, and a commitment to empowering our people and communities.
  
  
For more information, visit www.jameshardie.com.

**Summary**
-----------

The Executive Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and executive support to members of the James Hardie Executive Leadership Team. This role will also manage a variety of administrative projects.

**What You’ll Do:**
-------------------

* Collaborate proactively with leaders across the organization to gather comprehensive updates and develop dynamic agenda items for meetings, ensuring alignment on key objectives and initiatives.
* Lead the creation and refinement of presentation materials for executive leadership, town halls, and other high-visibility forums, effectively conveying strategic messages and business priorities.
* Manage the end-to-end planning and execution of programs, events, meetings, and conferences, including securing venues, coordinating with caterers, distributing information and invitations, organizing speakers, managing event budgets, and overseeing all related logistics to ensure seamless operations.
* Support and strengthen collaboration between the main office and regional offices through effective coordination and communication of activities and initiatives.
* Serve as a key liaison with internal departments, senior leaders, and external partners, fostering productive relationships and facilitating cross-functional teamwork.
* Provide high-level administrative support to C-Level executives and management teams, addressing a variety of needs and priorities on an as-needed basis.
* Represent the executive and the company with professionalism and integrity, serving as an ambassador in both internal and external engagements.
* Maintain strict confidentiality of all corporate, personnel, and team matters; uphold the highest ethical standards in all business practices and interactions.
* Continuously identify opportunities to enhance and optimize administrative processes and procedures, offering thoughtful suggestions for improvement and efficiency.
* Provide back-up support for receptionist duties as needed, ensuring continuity of front-office operations.
* Project manage key strategic projects from inception through completion, including developing project plans, coordinating cross-functional teams, tracking milestones and deliverables, and communicating progress to stakeholders to ensure successful execution and achievement of business goals.

**What You’ll Bring:**
----------------------

* Hold a high school diploma or equivalent as a minimum requirement, with a preference for candidates who have earned a college degree.
* Bring at least five years of proven professional experience supporting executives in high-level administrative roles.
* Demonstrate advanced proficiency in all Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and Outlook, to streamline processes and drive productivity.
* Leverage experience with SharePoint and Webex to facilitate seamless collaboration and communication across teams.
* Plan and execute events for groups ranging from 10 to 200 participants, ensuring flawless delivery and memorable attendee experiences.
* Exhibit outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with a mastery of grammar and the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
* Work independently with minimal supervision, consistently taking initiative to anticipate and address needs.
* Exercise sound independent judgment and make informed decisions that support organizational goals.
* Exhibit exceptional attention to detail and superior organizational skills in all aspects of work.
* Demonstrate the ability to prioritize tasks, consistently meet deadlines, and adapt quickly to changing priorities.
* Uphold professionalism and composure while working under pressure and tight deadlines.
* Proactively identify and resolve problems, displaying initiative and resourcefulness in finding effective solutions.
* Successfully coordinate and manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely and high-quality outcomes.
* Maintain strict confidentiality and handle sensitive information with the utmost discretion.
* Bring a positive attitude and demonstrate the ability to be proactive, resourceful, and adaptable in a dynamic environment.
* Show strong interpersonal skills, working collaboratively as part of a team and building effective relationships throughout the organization.

**What You’ll Receive:**
------------------------

As of the date of this posting, a good faith estimate of the current pay scale for this position is $31-$38/hour. Placement in the range depends on several factors such as experience, skills, geography and internal equity and may change over time. This position qualifies for benefits.

**START YOUR JOURNEY WITH US**

When you join the Sheraton Garden Grove - Anaheim South family, you become part of a global community. Since 1937, Sheraton has been a place to gather and connect. At Sheraton, associates create a sense of belonging in more than 400 communities around the world. We invite, we welcome, and we connect guests through engaging experiences and thoughtful service. Join us on our mission to be 'The World's Gathering Place'! A key responsibility of this position is providing weekend event and Sales & Catering coverage. * Assists with client communication and follow-up by telephone and email as directed.
* Provides administrative support for proposals, event correspondence, client files, appointments, calendars, and other Sales & Catering documentation.
* Communicates with Food & Beverage, Front Desk, Housekeeping, Engineering, and other departments regarding event and group requirements.
* Assists with event setup coordination and conducts event-space checks as needed.
* Monitors assigned events while in progress and communicates client requests, concerns, or operational issues to the appropriate manager or department.
* Assists with transitioning clients and event information to the appropriate operational teams.
* Maintains organized and accurate event and catering files and records.

new_jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT DOT.CARDS**
===================

dot.cards is the digital business card of the future. We produce premium networking hardware that pairs with a software platform that lets anyone share their contact info, in seconds. With 2.5M+ devices sold and 100M+ in-person connections facilitated, we have built strong momentum and clear product-market fit. We are now focused on scaling that foundation significantly across channels, products, and customer segments. Based in LA, we are a revenue-backed, fast-growing company entering our next phase of growth.

**THE ROLE**
============

We are hiring an Operations Coordinator to support the Head of Operations. This is a full-time, entry-level role for someone who wants to learn how a hardware company runs, from the factory to the customer.

Reporting directly to the Head of Operations, you will act as their right hand on operations: keeping inventory, suppliers, shipments, and reporting on track, and making sure commitments made get done.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
====================

* Coordinate with customer support, sales, procurement and the warehouse to support the custom product order process from order confirmation to delivery.
* Support weekly Amazon FBA replenishment: build the order, confirm inventory quantities, and review with Head of Operations for approval of shipping carton labels.
* Assist the Head of Sales by tracking action items from meetings, and follow up directly with owners on status and deadlines until each one is closed
* Track product development status, collect prototype and production quotes, sample shipments, follow up on action items and keep the product development tracker current.
* Coordinate monthly sales and operations planning (S&OP) readiness across departments and schedule meetings accordingly.
* Write and maintain SOPs for recurring operations workflows and flag any workflow that has not been written down yet.
* Coordinate in-house sample production, prioritize production schedule maintain inventory levels and document most effective customization parameters.
* Maintain one running list of open items with owner and due date and flag anything overdue or at risk.
* Check vendor invoices and forward them to accounts payable and receipts to our expense system
* Set up new SKUs, bundles, and maintain item master data in our document control database.
* Handle office facilities requests, including cleaning and other vendors and landlord requests
* Draft decks, spreadsheets, and briefs for review
* Order lab and office supplies and keep them stocked

**WHAT YOU WILL LEARN**
=======================

* How a hardware company runs operations end to end, working directly with the Head of Sales and Operations
* Supply chain and procurement with overseas manufacturers, from purchase order to delivered goods
* 3PL fulfillment and inventory planning across Shopify, Amazon, and TikTok Shop
* How operations reporting drives purchasing and planning decisions

  **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**
  ===========================

**Required**
------------

* 1 to 3 years of experience in an operations, logistics, coordinator, or executive assistant role, ideally in a fast-moving environment; also open to recent graduates and students in their final year of study with relevant internship or part-time experience
* Interest in supply chain, logistics, or manufacturing, through coursework, internships, or work experience
* Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets: comfortable with formulas, pivot tables, and building trackers from scratch
* Detail-oriented and organized, comfortable juggling multiple trackers, deadlines, and follow-ups at once
* Comfortable following up with people, including holding others accountable to deadlines they have committed to
* Clear written communicator who can draft a professional email or message without heavy editing
* Reliable, shows up, and follows through without needing reminders
* Comfortable asking questions and flagging problems early rather than guessing
* Able to lift and pack boxes up to 25 lbs

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with Shopify, Amazon Seller Central, or a 3PL or warehouse management portal

**COMPENSATION & DETAILS**
==========================

* $29.00 to $34.00/hour
* Full-time, entry level
* Onsite at dot.cards HQ in Culver City, CA
* Start date: as soon as we find the right person
* Reports to: Head of Sales and Operations

**Equal Opportunity Employer:** dot.cards is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

**Accommodation Statement:** We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process. If you require assistance or accommodation, please contact hr@dot.cards.

new_jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
At Our Place, we believe in the power of home-cooking to bring people together. We design thoughtful, beautiful products that make cooking and sharing meals easier and more joyful—and we are building a brand that earns a meaningful place in customers’ homes over time.

Welcome to Our Place. We believe that sharing a home-cooked meal is the very best way to connect. That’s why we create products that simplify home-cooking; it’s why we celebrate traditions with families given, chosen, and found; and it’s why we share those stories with you, directly from the people and places where they originate.

The Social Media Coordinator/ Content Creator reports to the Head of Social and is responsible for executing high-impact, social-first video content that drives engagement, brand awareness, and revenue growth across Our Place. This role is hands-on and execution-focused, with ownership of day-to-day TikTok content creation, video production, community-driven initiatives, specific Founder-led content, and platform growth strategies. The Social Media Coordinator/ Content Creator partners closely with the Founders, Creative, and Marketing teams to bring the brand to life through compelling, timely, and culturally relevant content.

**We have a hybrid working culture and are looking for this person to be on site 2 - 3 times a week at our brand new Our Place headquarters in West Los Angeles.**

### **What you'd do**

* **Content Creation & Production**

  + Interpret the monthly social media calendar to develop and execute TikTok content aligned with strategy, marketing goals, brand, and messaging guidelines
  + Lead end-to-end TikTok content production, including ideation, filming, editing, and publishing with oversight and creative direction from the Head of Social
  + Be comfortable creating food and cooking-focused content, including basic food preparation and minimal food styling for camera
  + Deliver a minimum of one TikTok per weekday and one Founder-led piece of content per month
* **Community Engagement**

  + Lead and manage the TikTok Bulletin Board and Instagram Broadcast Channel, driving community engagement initiatives tied to product drops and key brand moments
  + Support the Head of Social in community management across all social platforms by monitoring comments, engaging with followers, and identifying opportunities to drive engagement and brand affinity
* **Planning & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

  + Assist the Head of Social in executing social and brand-building initiatives, coordinating across teams on projects including events, influencer and community seeding, partnerships, and other key brand moments.
  + Plan and deliver weekly TikTok content strategy meetings with the Head of Social, ensuring all content is produced ahead of scheduled posting dates and executed within established timelines and budgets
  + Partner cross-functionally with Social, Creative Production, and Marketing teams as needed.

### **Who you are**

* 1–2 years of experience in social media, content creation, or a related role
* Strong interest in social media, pop culture, food, and trends
* A genuine love of food and cooking, with an eye for how food can be captured beautifully and naturally on social
* Familiarity with TikTok, Instagram, and evolving social platforms, with an understanding of what feels native to each
* Comfortable filming and editing short-form video content, with an eagerness to continue developing these skills
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple tasks, priorities, and deadlines with guidance from the Head of Social
* Flexible and willing to travel locally to Our Place stores, events, shoots, and other locations to capture content as needed
* Adaptable and comfortable with shifting priorities, quick turnarounds, and last-minute opportunities
* Action-oriented, proactive, and willing to jump in wherever needed
* Collaborative, receptive to feedback, and eager to learn and grow within the Social team

### **What we offer at Our Place**

* Competitive pay and real-deal equity — we want you to have a slice of what we’re building together
* A chance to share in our wins — all full-time team members are eligible for our discretionary annual bonus plan
* Benefits that actually benefit — top-tier medical, dental, and vision to keep you feeling your best
* Plenty of time off — generous PTO, and synchronized time off (we all log off together so you can actually rest)
* We invest in you — $500 a year for learning & development, plus an optional 401k plan so future you is covered
* All the kitchen treats — team member discount, an annual our place gift card, and of course, lots of our place goodies for your home
* A workspace worth leaving your house for — a beautiful office with a creative studio, multiple kitchens, and plenty of room for big ideas
* Tuesday lunches — catered meals so you can catch up with your teammates over something delicious
* A culture of connection — team events, activities, and an annual company retreat because we like hanging out together
* A team full of kind, thoughtful humans who actually care — because the people make this place

*This range reflects the good-faith estimate of compensation Our Place reasonably expects to pay for the position upon hire.*

  

*All information you submit in connection with your application to Our Place is processed in accordance with Our Place's* *Global Applicant Privacy Policy**.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

new_jobs.title: Client Services Coordinator (100% Remote)
new_jobs.description:
WR Immigration is a global immigration firm known worldwide for its innovation, technology, and high touch legal services. With offices across multiple time zones, the firm provides corporate global visa services in over 100 countries. WR is one of the fastest growing immigration service providers worldwide with over 46 attorneys and 200 immigration professionals working out of offices in Boston, Denver, Los Angeles, New York, Oakland, San Diego, San Francisco, Santa Monica, and Shanghai.

  

The Client Services Coordinator provides critical support to partners, attorneys, and members of the legal team by performing tasks related to client onboarding, reporting, and data management. Client Services Coordinators focus primarily on supporting large clients, but may also work with smaller clients or perform tasks that are not specific to any particular clients.

  

WR Immigration is looking to add a Client Services Coordinator to our Santa Monica team. This is a full-time, exempt role that can be performed remotely, in-office, or on a hybrid model. Remote applicants will be considered but must be located in the Pacific Time Zone.

  

Client Services Coordinator Responsibilities:

* Participating in the onboarding process for new corporate clients, including collecting and organizing documents, working alongside the WRapid team to ensure internal platforms are set up accurately, and assisting Partners and Managing Attorneys with responses to client questions.
* Collaborating with Partners and Managing Attorneys to prepare and deliver a variety of documents such as reports, dashboards, and client-specific tools.
* Developing advanced familiarity with WRapid report generation, filtering, subscriptions, etc. so that reporting responsibilities can be met.
* Creating reports needed for legal team success.
* Using templates to draft and update billing, budgeting, and forecasting reports.
* Performing regular analysis of information gathered through standard reports and communicating applicable findings to Leadership/Partners.
* Assisting with maintaining data integrity in WRapid and monitoring/updating any data discrepancies.
* Supporting the implementation of initiatives to maintain and ensure integrity and organization of client information.
* Maintaining subject matter expertise for multiple major clients.
* Assisting Attorneys in the development of training materials for client presentations and assisting in presenting when appropriate.
* Working alongside Business Development team members to prepare and organize information for Requests for Proposal.
* Assisting with data integrity/adherence reviews.
* Assisting with employee record creation and case initiation, as necessary (usually only in the case of change of counsel with high volume initiation).
* Extracting, saving, and logging documents received for each foreign national and identifying missing documents.
* Performing thorough and accurate document management and data entry.
* Performing legal record-keeping and database management tasks.
* Other duties as assigned.

  

Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree (required) with strong academic background
* At least 2 years of business immigration as a paralegal working on NIV cases preferred  
  + If no paralegal experience, 3-5 years of business immigration experience in another role can be substituted
* Excellent attention to detail
* Proven organizational, process, and computer skills, including proficiency in Excel

  

**Compensation & Work Location:**

This is a remote, full-time regular position. The pay rate for this role is $65,000 - $70,000 annualized.

  

**Benefits:**

WR Immigration offers a robust and competitive suite of benefits designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our team members. Benefits for full-time employees include paid time off and paid holidays; medical, dental, vision, and life insurance coverage; health savings and flexible spending accounts to help offset healthcare and dependent care expenses; multiple retirement plan options (401k & Roth 401k); and access to an employee assistance program. Benefits availability and eligibility may vary based on role and employment status.

  

**Additional Information:**

WR Immigration is committed to creating, fostering, and preserving an inclusive environment. We support our team members from all nations and backgrounds to achieve their goals and build lives of purpose and success. We recognize that our team members bring diverse talents, skills, and experiences, and we believe it is our responsibility to create an inclusive and respectful workplace that inspires excellence and compassion, both internally and in our service to clients.

  

**Please note, we are not working with outside recruiters for this position.**

WR Immigration does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. The firm will not be responsible for any referral fees or other compensation in the absence of a signed agreement between WR Immigration and the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes submitted without such an agreement, including those sent directly to hiring managers, will be considered the property of WR Immigration, and the firm reserves the right to pursue and hire candidates submitted in this manner without financial obligation.

OCTA is seeking an experienced marketing professional to develop and execute innovative, integrated marketing programs that increase awareness, engagement, and use of OCTA programs and services.

The Senior Marketing Specialist leads and manages marketing campaigns and programs with an emphasis on research, strategic planning, execution, promotion, and evaluation. The Principal Marketing Specialist provides broader strategic leadership for complex marketing initiatives, partner marketing, business and community outreach, and cross-channel programs.

This recruitment may be filled at either the Senior Marketing Specialist or Principal Marketing Specialist level based on the selected candidate's experience and qualifications.

**Marketing Specialist, Principal -** This is an exempt position in salary grade 200: Min $96,449.60 - Mid $114,587.20 - Max $132,704.00/year. The starting salary will be within this range based on qualifications.

* Collaborate across OCTA to develop creative solutions that support transportation programs and services

* Experience developing campaigns, managing vendors or consultants, analyzing market data, and monitoring budgets
* Strong writing, presentation, project management, and collaboration skills

new_jobs.title: Account Manager, SMC
new_jobs.description:
Snap Inc is a technology company. We believe the camera presents the greatest opportunity to improve the way people live and communicate. Snap contributes to human progress by empowering people to express themselves, live in the moment, learn about the world, and have fun together.

  
  

The Company operates Snapchat , a visual messaging app that enhances your relationships with friends, family, and the world, and Specs Inc. , a wholly-owned subsidiary dedicated to making computing more human, in addition to Bitmoji , Saturn, and other digital services.

  
  

We’re looking for an Account Manager to join our global Small and Medium Customers (SMC) organization! As a member of the Sales team, you will work in a fun, fast-paced, and fluid environment. You will need to bring a creative mindset, detail-oriented focus, and strategic acumen in your approach to building and growing long term business partnerships across brands and their partners.

  

What you’ll do:

* Build, manage, and grow relationships and spend with key clients and agency partners by helping them achieve performance that exceeds advertiser expectations
* Partner with account executives and creative strategists throughout the RFP process to develop innovative, insight-driven digital campaigns on Snapchat, bringing measurable ROI for our clients
* Manage projects involving complex work streams and cross-functional collaboration (internally and externally)
* Dive deep into campaign performance data; guiding KPI-driven measurement strategies, identifying performance trends, optimizing campaigns to achieve results, and providing recommendations for upsell opportunities
* Serve as the product expert by educating brands and agencies on Snap’s new and existing products, as well as advising on best practices and bespoke campaign optimizations
Increase adoption and engagement of Snap’s self-service platform and auction-based tools, providing ongoing technical support and real-time analysis  

  

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

* Understanding of advertising performance metrics and ecosystem
* Understanding of media management within a biddable auction advertising environment and demonstrated skill in educating others (e.g., advertisers, agencies)
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, as well as experience with analyzing datasets, and delivering actionable insights
* Strong communication skills; both written and verbal
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and all levels of management (internally and externally)
* Ability to manage multiple projects with strong attention to detail
Ability to work in a fast paced environment and adapt to changes  

Minimum Qualifications:

* BS/BA degree in business, communications, marketing, or another related area of study or equivalent years of experience
* 3+ years proven experience taking complex data and evaluating success metrics to create data stories that drive campaign performance
* 3+ years working with clients to understand the brand strategy, product attributes, main competitors, and major issues facing their business while performing in-depth data analysis that deliver both short and long term strategies
Experience in the digital media industry with a focus on performance and brand marketing, ad-tech, programmatic in real-time bidding marketplaces, or a related field  

Preferred Qualifications:

* Pre-existing relationships with client decision-makers and brand marketers
* Proven track record of delivering on quota and obtaining positive reviews
* A passion for Snapchat as a user and knowledge of our ad products

To reflect this, we practice a “default together” approach and expect our team members to work in an office 4+ days per week.

  
  

At Snap, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to create innovative products that improve the way people live and communicate. Snap is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, pregnancy, childbirth and breastfeeding, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other protected classification, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. EOE, including disability/vets.

new_jobs.title: Trust Operations - Client Services
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

The Trust Operations Specialist - Client Service answers questions regarding investments in private equity, real estate, private debt, and more. Effectively handles client inquiries by researching and analyzing complex issues. Adheres strictly to trust regulations and security standards including the customer identification program (KYC), the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act, Bank Secrecy Act, Internal Revenue Code, and all other applicable banking and trust regulation set forth by the IRS and other regulatory agencies.

Acts as the face of the company at the frontlines of the customer service experience. Provides superior customer service through an omni-channel environment including chat, written correspondence, incoming calls, outbound calls, and emails to both internal and external parties such as clients, asset sponsors, financial advisors, attorneys, CPAs etc. Represents the company in a highly professional manner while resolving issues and communicating information confidently.

* Use working knowledge of various processes, asset types, and service levels across the firm to quickly analyze the root cause of issues and determine the correct course of action, following up on the item to ensure ultimate resolution.
* Mitigate company risk through following all security and fraud prevention requirements.
* Educate advisors, clients, and third parties on do’s and don'ts of alternative asset investing, working with the Company, applicable fees & fee schedules, timelines and procedures for account opening, funding and investing, and ERISA guidelines.
* Prepare and archive professional correspondence.
* Investigate account issues by analyzing investment and transactional activity and/or errors; complex compliance issues pertaining to IRS rules and regulations
* Identify, analyze, resolve and report on specific client requests and issues.
* Develop expertise to provide clients on-going support and assistance.
* Manage low level escalations, including ability to draft free form professional responses to client escalations and inquiries.
* Identify, recommend and potentially design and assist in the development and implementation of process improvements that enhance the client experience.
* Accurately file reports on client issues for management review.
* Analyze trends in client issues in order to facilitate service improvement.
* Other duties as assigned.

**About You:**

* H.S. Diploma/GED required.
* Bachelor's Degree preferred.
* 2+ years' experience in a customer success role involving highly detailed transactions required.
* 1-2 years' experience in a fast-paced call center environment preferred.
* Working knowledge of trust accounting systems, IRAs, and Alternative Assets is preferred.
* Certified IRA Services Professional (CISP) designation with the American Bankers Association (ABA) preferred.
* Self-Directed IRA Professional (SDIP) designation from the Retirement Industry Trust Association (RITA) preferred.
* Proficient in IRC 4975, prohibited transactions and all other ERISA guidelines.
* Proficient in IRS publication 590 and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Knowledge of operational procedures, practices and policies.
* Demonstrates the ability to sell Bank products and services.
* Able to mentor new associates through on the job training.
* Requires the ability to multi-task and work with over 25 software applications.
* Requires intermediate computer skills, including MS Office and banking software.
* Skill in basic troubleshooting: mobile devices, browsers, and other technology as it relates to online banking.
* Thorough understanding of products and services offered by bank. Advanced knowledge in specialty area.
* Excellent customer service skills and ability to work effectively with the public.

The pay range for this role is $25.00 to $34.00.

The pay rate for the selected candidate is dependent upon a variety of non-discriminatory factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience, education, and geographic location. The role may be eligible for performance-based incentive compensation, and those details will be provided during the recruitment process.

1045 W Katella Avenue Suite 100 Orange CA 92867

We are proud to offer a competitive total rewards package including base wages and comprehensive benefits.

We offer eligible associates comprehensive healthcare coverage (medical, dental, and vision plans), a 401(k)-retirement savings plan with employer match for qualifying associate contributions, an employee assistance program, life insurance, disability insurance, tuition assistance, mental health resources, identity theft protection, legal support, auto and home insurance, pet insurance, access to an online discount marketplace, and paid vacation, sick days, volunteer days, and holidays. Benefit eligibility begins the first day of the month following the date of hire for associates who are regularly scheduled to work at least thirty hours weekly.

new_jobs.description:
An ABM Onsite Service Assistant Project Manager - Janitorial for the Sports & Entertainment Vertical Market is responsible for the operational and financial success of his/her project. This person leads a diverse team, engages in regular client interaction, ensures quality services are provided at the site in alignment with contractual agreements and budgetary requirements, achieves operational and financial goals, plans and directs activities to promote project profitability, meets financial objectives by controlling expenses, retaining current customer(s), and expanding billable services.

**Compensation:** *$80,000.00 annual salary (US Dollars)*

The pay listed is the salary range for this position. Any specific offer will vary based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data. You may be eligible to participate in a Company incentive or bonus program

**Benefits:** *ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit* Recruiting Flyer - Staff & Mgmt

* Supervise the daily activities of operations team members.
* Set priorities for the team to ensure completion of tasks.
* Effectively recruit, manage, and lead a team with focus on maintaining the functionality and safety of operations.
* Participate in monitoring and developing team member performance, including evaluations, training, and recognition.
* Ensure work assignments and schedules meet department, facility, and contractual needs.
* Respond to client inquiries, requests, and concerns.
* Utilize company policies and guidelines to solve work problems.
* Ensure department training programs and recertification programs are being conducted within appropriate timeframes.
* Meet with clients to ensure needs and expectations are being met.
* Implement and manage quality control monitoring and safety programs; maintain a safe work environment.
* Achieve operational performance and functional service activities.
* Provide technical guidance and interpret policies and procedures to assist employees in performing functional tasks.
* Monitor and maintain appropriate staffing levels and daily schedules.
* Obtains updates of completed work from the various site trade groups for confirmation of work completions or to determine reason for inability of maintain the schedule. Manages tracking of open work requests and work packages that have been planned and are awaiting scheduling.
* Performs other duties as assigned or requested.

* One to three years of facilities management experience is preferred.
* Bilingual (English and Spanish) preferred.
* Ability to work night shift.
* Ability to adjust work schedule as needed to support the operation.
* Ability to effectively lead a staff of direct reports.
* Ability to effectively communicate and to read and interpret documents including safety rules, operating and procedural manuals, and handbooks.
* Basic understanding of computer programs, including Microsoft Office.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced work environment.
* Ability to resolve issues under tight timeframes and pressure.
* Ability to prioritize assignments and projects and to multi-task within restricted time constraints.
* Excellent team building and planning skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills; ability to develop productive business relationships, and ability to influence and educate employees.

We will provide you with assistance and make a determination on your request for reasonable accommodation on a case-by-case basis.

  

ABM participates in the U.S. Department of Homeland Security E-Verify program. E-Verify is an internet-based system used to electronically confirm employment eligibility.
