new_jobs.description:
Executive Assistant - Fourth Presbyterian Church

**Executive Assistant to the Senior Pastor/Head of Staff**

**Fourth Presbyterian Church of Chicago, Illinois**

**September 2026**

**Classification:** Exempt

**Status:** Regular, Full-time

**Reports To:** Senior Pastor and Head of Staff

**Location:** Downtown Chicago, IL

**About Fourth Presbyterian Church**

Fourth Presbyterian Church is a vibrant, inclusive, and service-oriented community in the heart of downtown Chicago. Guided by our Long-Range Plan, we are committed to deepening faith, building connections, fostering community partnerships, and ensuring long-term sustainability through thoughtful leadership and innovation. Through its nonprofit partner Chicago Lights, Fourth Church also provides life-changing community programs including tutoring, social services, and the Chicago Lights Urban Farm.

**Position Overview**

The Executive Assistant provides high-level, confidential, and proactive executive support to the Senior Pastor/Head of Staff of Fourth Presbyterian Church. The Executive Assistant also supports the Senior Associate Pastor and the Executive Director of Operational Ministries.

This is a highly trusted position that serves as an essential partner to the Senior Pastor in managing the complexity, pace, relationships, and priorities associated with leading a large, historic, urban congregation. The Executive Assistant ensures that the Senior Pastor is prepared to lead effectively across the many dimensions of their ministry—including worship and preaching, pastoral care, staff leadership, congregational life, Session leadership, stewardship and resource development, denominational relationships, community engagement, and the broader life of the city.

The Executive Assistant serves as a key point of connection between the Senior Pastor and members, officers, staff, denominational leaders, community partners, clergy colleagues, donors, visitors, and other internal and external constituencies. The position requires exceptional judgment, discretion, emotional intelligence, hospitality, organizational ability, and the capacity to anticipate needs before they become urgent.

The successful candidate will bring both executive-level administrative excellence and a deep respect for the pastoral nature of the Senior Pastor’s work. The person will understand that many of the matters coming through the Senior Pastor’s office involve people’s lives, faith, grief, celebrations, relationships, and deeply personal circumstances and therefore require warmth, tact, confidentiality, and care. The Executive Assistant will help create the conditions in which the Senior Pastor can focus on the highest priorities of her ministry and leadership while ensuring that commitments, communications, meetings, and follow-through are handled with precision and grace.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

**Executive Support and Partnership**

* Serve as the primary administrative partner to the Senior Pastor, developing a highly effective working relationship built on trust, communication, discretion, and mutual respect. Manage the Senior Pastor’s complex and dynamic calendar, maintaining a forward-looking calendar that allows the Senior Pastor to prepare appropriately for significant meetings, worship services, presentations, sermons, public engagements, and pastoral responsibilities.

* Coordinate meetings for the Senior Associate Pastor and Executive Director of Operational Ministries and maintain their calendars.

* Proactively anticipate scheduling conflicts, competing priorities, preparation requirements, travel considerations, and other logistical needs.

* Prepare the Senior Pastor for meetings by gathering agendas, briefing materials, background information, participant information, previous correspondence, and other relevant materials. Monitor commitments and follow-up items arising from meetings and engagements and help ensure timely completion or delegation.

* Triage requests for the Senior Pastor’s time and attention, exercising sound judgment about urgency, importance, confidentiality, and appropriate routing.

* Serve as an effective gatekeeper while maintaining a welcoming and hospitable presence.

* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, itineraries, accommodations, transportation, meeting schedules, and related logistics as needed.

* Maintain an organized system for tracking invitations, speaking engagements, appointments, deadlines, correspondence, and follow-up.

* Provide administrative support for special projects and emerging priorities identified by the Senior Pastor.

**Staff Support to the Joint Finance Council, the Board of Trustees, and the Session.**

* Coordinate the Senior Pastor’s responsibilities related to Session meetings and activities. Support the Senior Pastor in their role as Moderator of Session.

* Schedule, coordinate logistics and meals, and serve as hospitality for all meetings. Take and prepare minutes at all meetings. Maintain all Presbyterian Church USA requirements for the maintenance and archiving of Session and Board of Trustees minutes.

* Work closely with the Senior Pastor, other clergy, and congregational leadership to coordinate calendars, agendas, meeting materials, logistics, communications, and follow-up.

* Prepare and organize materials needed for meetings and communications. Proofread and review materials and assist with preparation of scripts, announcements, presentations, and other materials.

* Provide staff support for committees, task forces, councils, or special groups assigned.

* Support the transition and orientation of newly elected officers in partnership with appropriate pastoral and administrative staff.

* Coordinate officer committee assignments in partnership with the Senior Pastor, Senior Associate Pastor and appropriate staff.

new_jobs.title: Marketing & Business Development Assistant, Transactional
new_jobs.description:
**About Kirkland & Ellis**

At Kirkland & Ellis, we don’t just meet the standard for legal excellence — we set it. Our culture is built on teamwork, ingenuity and an unwavering commitment to continuous growth. We tackle the most sophisticated legal challenges with bold ideas and innovative solutions, powered by the exceptional experience and ambition of our 7,000+ people, including 4,000+ attorneys, across 24 offices worldwide. Our dedicated professionals share our lawyers’ commitment to excellence and show up each day to do meaningful work that helps drive global business, investment and innovation forward.

**What You’ll Do**

Are you a detail-oriented professional who enjoys turning data, research and insights into compelling business development materials?

**Kirkland & Ellis** is seeking a **Marketing & Business Development Assistant** to join the Firm’s Marketing & Business Development (MBD) Department in our Chicago office supporting our premier Private Equity/M&A practice.

In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with attorneys and colleagues across the Firm to deliver high-quality, client-facing materials, conduct market research and maintain critical business development data and systems. Your work will directly support strategic business development initiatives and help showcase the Firm's experience, relationships and market-leading position.

The MBD department operates from a team-first position and values collaboration, accountability, intellectual curiosity and open communication. You’ll have success in this role by bringing a proactive approach, strong business judgement and commitment to delivering exceptional service to attorneys, clients and colleagues.

You will report to the Associate Director of Practice Development in Chicago and collaborate regularly with an international team of problem-solvers and advisers dedicated to the broader business development, research, marketing and communications efforts of the Firm.

* **Provide Pitch, Proposal & Presentation Support:** Assist in the production of bespoke, client-facing pitch materials, presentations, and responses to RFPs, including compiling, proofreading, formatting, editing, printing and delivery.
* **Conduct Research & Market Intelligence:** Conduct research on clients, potential clients, competitors, industries, markets and emerging trends using internal and external platforms, including Bloomberg, CapIQ, Mergermarket and PitchBook to support decision-making.
* **Analyze Data & Prepare Reporting:** Compile, organize and prepare data related to client relationships, market activity, matters, transactions and business development efforts to support attorneys, business development professionals and other Firm stakeholders.
* **Manage Business Development Content:** Maintain accurate, updated and reusable content related to practices, industries, attorneys and representative matters for use across business development initiatives.
* **Support Experience & Deal Tracking:** Support the review, approval and submission of transaction data to external ranking and market intelligence providers, ensuring consistency, accuracy and effective positioning of the Firm's experience.
* **Maintain CRM & Marketing Systems:** Maintain data within the Firm’s CRM and other MBD systems, including managing mailing lists, updating contact records, tracking client interactions, conducting database audits and supporting data integrity initiatives.
